title: Syrian official says ‘no plans’ to establish Turkish military presence
english: Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad al-Shaibani has denied claims that Turkey is establishing a military base at the Abu al-Duhur airfield following recent Israeli airstrikes on the site. He clarified that Turkish officials only visited for training purposes and that no permanent military deployment was ever planned. Meanwhile, Israel maintains that the strikes were a warning against Turkish involvement in the area, leading to heightened tensions between the two nations.
amharic: የሶሪያ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አስዓድ አል-ሻይባኒ፣ እስራኤል በአቡ አል-ዱሁር የአየር ማረፊያ ላይ ጥቃት ካደረሰች በኋላ ቱርክ በቦታው ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ እንደምትገነባ የሚነገረውን ወሬ ውድቅ አድርገዋል። የቱርክ ወታደራዊ ባለስልጣናት ቦታውን የጎበኙት ለስልጠና ብቻ እንደሆነና በቦታው ቋሚ ወታደራዊ መገኘት እቅድ እንደሌለ አስረድተዋል። እስራኤል በበኩሏ ጥቃቱን የፈፀመችው በቱርክ ተሳትፎ ላይ ማስጠንቀቂያ ለመስጠት እንደሆነ በመግለጽ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን ውጥረት አባብሳለች።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Siiriyaa Asaad al-Shaibanii, erga xiyyiin Israa'el buufata xiyyaaraa Abuu al-Duhuur irratti darbee booda, Turkiin buufata waraanaa achi keessatti hundeeffachuu ishee ilaalchisee odeeffamu soba jechuun haalaniiru. Aangeyyoonni Turkiyyi bakke sana kan daawwatan leenjiif qofa akka ta'ee fi waraanni Turkiyyi achi qubachuuf karoora akka hin qabne ibsaniiru. Israa'el gamasaatiin, haleellaan kun hirmaannaa Turkiyyii akkeekkachiisuuf kan raawwatame ta'uu ibsuun, walitti bu'iinsa biyyoota lamaanii hammaachiseera.

title: Taliban secures pragmatic global alliances without formal recognition
english: Five years after returning to power, the Taliban has successfully built regional partnerships in trade, energy, and security despite lacking widespread international recognition. While most of the world has not officially acknowledged their government, the Taliban currently maintains diplomatic engagements with over 40 missions globally. China has become a primary economic partner through major mining investments, even as relations with other neighbors like Pakistan remain complicated.
amharic: ታሊባን ወደ ስልጣን ከተመለሰ አምስት ዓመታት በኋላ፣ ዓለም አቀፍ እውቅና ባያገኝም በተለያዩ የንግድ፣ የኢነርጂ እና የፀጥታ ዘርፎች የክልል አጋርነት መፍጠር ችሏል። አብዛኛው የዓለም ሀገራት መንግስታቸውን በይፋ ባይቀበሉም፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት ከ40 በላይ ዲፕሎማቲክ ተልዕኮዎች ጋር ግንኙነት እየተደረገ ይገኛል። በተለይም ቻይና በትላልቅ የማዕድን ኢንቨስትመንቶች አማካኝነት ዋና የኢኮኖሚ አጋር ሆና ስትቀጥል፣ ከሌሎች ጎረቤት ሀገራት ጋር ያለው ግንኙነት ግን ውስብስብ ሆኖ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Taliban erga gara aangootti deebi'ee waggaa shan booda, hayyama idil-addunyaa guutuu hin qabaatinillee, daldala, anniisaa fi nageenya irratti walitti dhufeenya naannoo cimaa uumachuu danda'eera. Biyyoonni hedduun mootummaa isaanii ifatti kan hin beekne ta'us, amma yeroo ammaa gartuun sun ergamoota dippilomaasii 40 olii wajjin walitti dhufeenya qaba. Keessattuu Chaayinaan invastimantii qonnaan baasii gurguddaa irratti waliigaltee uumuun hiriyaa diinagdee ijoo taateetti, haa ta'u malee, walitti dhufeenyi biyyoota ollaa kanneen akka Paakistaan waliin qaban ammayyuu xaxamaadha.

title: Israeli authorities release body of slain Palestinian child held since March
english: Israeli authorities have returned the body of a Palestinian child, Salim Sami Salim Faqha, who was killed by military fire near Ramallah in March. The boy's remains were handed over to Palestinian officials for burial after being held by Israel for several months. This practice of withholding bodies has faced significant criticism from human rights groups, who argue it violates international humanitarian laws regarding the respectful treatment of the deceased.
amharic: የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት መጋቢት ወር ላይ በወታደራዊ ጥቃት የተገደለውን ሳሊም ሳሚ ሳሊም ፋቃ የተባለ ፍልስጤማዊ ህፃን አስከሬን ለቤተሰቦቹ አስረክበዋል። እስራኤል ለወራት አስከሬኑን ይዛ ከቆየች በኋላ ለፍልስጤም ባለስልጣናት ያስረከበች ሲሆን የቀብር ስነስርዓቱም በአገሩ ይከናወናል። ይህ አስከሬን የመያዝ ተግባር አለም አቀፍ የሰብአዊ መብት ድርጅቶችን ተቃውሞ የገጠመው ሲሆን፣ የሟቾችን ክብር የሚጻረር ድርጊት መሆኑም ተገልጿል።
oromo: Abbootiin taayitaa Israa'el ganna darbe ji'a Bitootessaa keessa naannoo Ramallaatti loltootaan ajjeefame ijoollee Phalasteen kan ta'e Saalim Saamii Saalim Faqhaa reeffa isaa maatii isaatiif deebisaniiru. Israa'el reeffa mucichaatii ji'oota hedduuf erga qabattee booda, ergaa achi booda gara dhaabbata fayyaa Phalasteenitti geeffamee akka awwaalamu taasifameera. Gochi reeffa qabachuu kun mirga namoomaa fi seera idil-addunyaa kan cabsu waan ta'eef, dhaabbileen mirga namoomaa gocha kana balaaleffataniiru.

title: Palestine groups call for London march against British 'complicity' in Gaza genocide
english: Pro-Palestine advocacy groups in the UK have scheduled a major protest in London for October 10 to mark the three-year anniversary of the conflict in Gaza. The coalition is calling on the British government to stop supplying arms and military support to Israel, arguing that the UK is complicit in the ongoing humanitarian crisis. Demonstrators are demanding that officials take concrete action to secure a permanent ceasefire and ensure unrestricted access for aid to reach the Palestinian people.
amharic: በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም የሚገኙ የፍልስጤም ደጋፊ ቡድኖች በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ያለውን ጦርነት ሶስት ዓመት ምክንያት በማድረግ በጥቅምት 10 ቀን በለንደን ትልቅ ሰልፍ እንደሚጠሩ አስታውቀዋል። አራማጆቹ የእንግሊዝ መንግሥት ለእስራኤል የሚሰጠውን የጦር መሳሪያና ወታደራዊ ድጋፍ በማቆም በችግሩ ላይ እጁ እንዳለበት በመግለጽ ተቃውሟቸውን ያሰማሉ። ተቃዋሚዎቹ መንግሥት ተኩስ እንዲቆም እና የሰብአዊ እርዳታ ያለ ምንም ገደብ እንዲገባ አፋጣኝ እርምጃ እንዲወስድ እየጠየቁ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Gareen deggartoota Falasxiin kan UK, waraana Gaaza keessatti waggaa sadii guutuu geggeeffamaa jiru mormuuf guraandhala 10 magaalaa Londonitti hiriira guddaa waamanii jiru. Dhaabbileen kun mootummaan Britaaniyaa gargaarsa meeshaa waraanaa Isiraa'eliif kennu akka dhaabuufi dhimma kana keessatti hirmaannaa qabaachuu isaa akka dhaabu gaafachaa jiru. Hiriirtotni mootummaan kun waraana akka dhaabsisuufi gargaarsi namoomaa daangaa malee Falasxiinota bira akka ga'uuf tarkaanfii qabatamaa akka fudhatu gaafatu.

title: Three Palestinian parties in Israel form joint list ahead of elections
english: Three Palestinian-led political parties in Israel have decided to run as a unified coalition in the upcoming October elections. By forming this alliance, the groups aim to increase their parliamentary influence and oppose what they describe as the right-wing government's discriminatory policies. While this group seeks to revive the historical 'Joint List,' the Ra'am party has chosen to remain independent and run its own separate campaign.
amharic: በእስራኤል የሚገኙ ሶስት የፍልስጤም የፖለቲካ ፓርቲዎች በመጪው ጥቅምት ወር በሚካሄደው ምርጫ በአንድነት ለመወዳደር ተስማምተዋል። ጥምረቱን የመሰረቱት ፓርቲዎች በፓርላማ ያላቸውን ተጽዕኖ በመጨመር አሁን ካለው የቀኝ ዘመም መንግስት ፖሊሲዎች ጋር ለመታገል አቅደዋል። ይህ ጥምረት የቀድሞውን የጋራ ዝርዝር (Joint List) ለማደስ ቢሞክርም፣ የራአም ፓርቲ ግን ከጥምረቱ ውጪ በተናጥል ለመወዳደር ወስኗል።
oromo: Paartiileen siyaasaa Falasxiin sadii Israa'el keessatti argaman filannoo guddicha Mudde dhufuuf jedhuuf tokko ta'uun akka dorgoman murteeffataniiru. Paartiileen kun waltajjii siyaasaa keessatti hirmaannaa isaanii dabaluufi mootummaa mirga isaanii sarbe jedhan mormuuf walta'iinsa kana uumaniiru. Yeroo kanaan dura 'Joint List' jedhamuun beekamu deebisanii ijaaruuf carraaqqii godhanis, paartiin Ra'am garuu walta'iinsa kana keessa galuu diduun kophatti dorgomuuf murteeffateera.

title: Israel issues veiled threat to Turkey following airbase strikes in Syria
english: Israel recently launched airstrikes on the Abu al-Duhur airbase in Syria, prompting Defense Minister Israel Katz to warn Turkey against its involvement in the region. While Israel claims the site threatened its security, both Turkish and Syrian officials deny any permanent Turkish military presence, stating that Turkish teams were merely assisting with infrastructure repairs. This confrontation has escalated diplomatic tensions, with Turkey criticizing the strikes as reckless and noting that a pre-existing communication channel between the two nations was ignored.
amharic: እስራኤል በቅርቡ በሶሪያ አቡ አል-ዱሁር የአየር ማረፊያ ላይ የአየር ድብደባ የፈፀመች ሲሆን የመከላከያ ሚኒስትሯ እስራኤል ካትዝ ቱርክ በክልሉ የምታደርገውን እንቅስቃሴ በማስጠንቀቅ ላይ ናቸው። እስራኤል ቦታው ደህንነቷን አደጋ ላይ ጥሏል ብትልም፣ የቱርክ እና የሶሪያ ባለስልጣናት ምንም አይነት የቱርክ ወታደራዊ ይዞታ እንደሌለ በመግለጽ፣ የቱርክ ቡድኖች የነበሩት ለስራ ማሻሻያ ስራ ብቻ መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ግጭት በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ውጥረት ያባባሰው ሲሆን፣ ቱርክ ጥቃቱን ሀላፊነት የጎደለው ድርጊት ብላ በመቃወም ቀደም ሲል የነበረው የመግባቢያ መስመር ችላ መባሉን ገልጻለች።
oromo: Israa'el dhiyeenya kana buufata xiyyaraa Abu al-Duhur kan Sooriyaa keessatti argamu irratti haleellaa qilleensaa raawwatteetti; Ministirri ittisaa Israa'el Israa'el Kaatz ammoo qindoomina Tarkiin naannichatti qabduun akeekkachiisaniiru. Israa'el bakkeen kun nageenya ishee waan miidhuuf haleellee jettee himattus, qondaaltoonni Tarkii fi Sooriyaa waraanni Tarkii achi akka hin jirre ibsaniiru; akkasumas gareen Tarkii achi turan kan deeggarsa suphaa buura misoomaa qofaaf akka ta'e dubbataniiru. Walitti buutiin kun hariiroo dippilomaasii biyyoota lamaanii kan jabeessu yoo ta'u, Tarkii haleellaa kana balaaleffachuun daandiin quunnamtii isaanii kan dursaa ture utuu jiruu Israa'el isa fayyadamuu dhiisuu ishee ibsiteetti.

title: Jason Arday's marathon challenge and football claims found to be true after his death
english: A recent analysis has confirmed that claims made by the late Cambridge academic Jason Arday, including his completion of 30 marathons for charity, were factual. Arday had faced significant public criticism and media scrutiny regarding his background and achievements following allegations of plagiarism. Despite the controversy surrounding his life and career, evidence supports his past accomplishments in long-distance running and charitable fundraising.
amharic: የቅርብ ጊዜ ጥናት እንደሚያሳየው በካምብሪጅ ዩኒቨርሲቲ መምህር የነበሩትና በቅርቡ ያረፉት ጄሰን አርዳይ በጎ አድራጎት ለማከናወን 30 ማራቶኖችን እንደሮጡ የተናገሩት እውነት መሆኑን አረጋግጧል። በአርዳይ ላይ ከዚህ ቀደም የቅጂ መብት ጥሰት ክሶች ቀርበውባቸው የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ የህይወት ታሪካቸውና ስኬቶቻቸው በተመለከተ የሰነዘሩት የይገባኛል ጥያቄዎች መሰረት ያላቸው መሆናቸው ታይቷል። በአሁኑ ወቅት የተደረገው ትንታኔ የቀድሞ አትሌቲክስ እና የበጎ አድራጎት ስራዎቻቸው እውነት መሆናቸውን በሰነዶች አረጋግጧል።
oromo: Qorannoon dhihoo kana gaggeeffame akka agarsiisutti, ogeessi barnootaa Yuunivarsiitii Kaambirijii kan turan Jason Arday, maratoonii 30 fageenya gabaabaa keessatti fiiguun isaanii dhugaa ta'uun mirkanaa'eera. Arday waa'ee jireenya isaanii fi eenyummaa isaaniitiin walqabatee komii fi gadi-qabbiin miidiyaalee irraa isaan mudachaa ture. Haata'u malee, qorannoon kun akka agarsiisutti, dubbiin isaan waa'ee fiigicha maratoonii fi hojii gaarummaa irratti dubbatan dhugaa ta'uun isaa ragaan mirkanaa'eera.

title: UK to lay out 'measures' against Israel over West Bank settlements
english: The British government has announced plans to implement measures, including potential sanctions, against Israel in response to new settlement construction projects near Jerusalem. Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband warned that these developments threaten the viability of a two-state solution by physically dividing the West Bank. London intends to finalize these restrictive policies in the coming weeks to address illegal settlement expansion and its impact on Palestinian communities.

Ministirri Dhimma Alaa biyyattii Ed Miliband, piroojektonni kun lafa Lixa Laga Yordaanos (West Bank) bakka lamatti hiruu dhaan furmaata biyya lamaa kan miidhu ta'uu ibsaniiru. title: How conflict is making life more expensive for Iranians
english: Iranians are facing severe financial hardship as the country's currency loses value and the cost of basic goods continues to climb. President Trump's recent pledge to intensify economic pressure on the nation has further exacerbated these concerns. Residents in major cities like Tehran are finding it increasingly difficult to afford daily necessities due to this ongoing economic instability.

oromo: Gatiin gabaa dabalaa fi gatiin mallaqa biyyaatii gadi bu'uun isaa ummanni Iraan rakkoo jireenyaa hamaa keessa akka jiran taasiseera. Haala kanaan, jiraattonni magaalaa Teheran gatii meeshaalee bu'uuraa baasuuf rakkachaa jiru.

title: State-backed Israeli settler violence forces West Bank displacement: HRW
english: A new Human Rights Watch report reveals that Israeli settlers, supported by state resources and protection, are systematically forcing Palestinians to leave their communities in the West Bank. The organization reports a significant rise in violent attacks, including assault and property destruction, which have led to more displacement in the first four months of this year than in all of 2025. Consequently, the rights group is urging international authorities to impose sanctions and halt military aid to Israel to address these escalating human rights abuses.
amharic: አዲስ የሰብአዊ መብት ተከራካሪ ቡድን (HRW) ባወጣው ሪፖርት መሠረት፣ የመንግሥት ድጋፍ የሚያገኙ የእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች በዌስት ባንክ የሚገኙ ፍልስጤማውያንን ከቀያቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ እያደረጉ ነው። ሪፖርቱ በሰፋሪዎች የሚፈጸመው ጥቃት፣ ንብረት ማውደም እና ግድያ ተባብሶ መቀጠሉን በመግለጽ፣ ይህ ድርጊት ከፈረንጆቹ 2025 ዓመት በጠቅላላ ከተመዘገበው በላይ የሰዎች መፈናቀል በአራት ወራት ውስጥ እንዲከሰት አድርጓል ብሏል። የሰብአዊ መብት ተከራካሪ ቡድኑ የዓለም አቀፍ ማህበረሰብ በእስራኤል ላይ ማዕቀብ እንዲጥል እና ወታደራዊ እርዳታ እንዲያቆም ጥሪ አቅርቧል።
oromo: Gabaasni haaraan Human Rights Watch baase akka ibsetti, qubattoonni Israa'el mootummaan deeggaraman, lammiilee Falasxiin naannoo West Bank irraa humnaan buqqisuu isaanii ibseera. Gabaasichi akka jedhutti, haleellaan qubattootaa fi miidhaan qabeenyaa irratti raawwatamu dabaluun, waggaa kana keessa ji'oota afur qofa keessatti namoota hedduu buqqiseera. Haala kanaan, dhaabbatichi mootummoonni biyyoota addunyaa Israa'el irratti tarkaanfii akkasumas gargaarsa waraanaa akka dhaaban gaafateera.

title: Are Hormuz ships more willing to defy Iran or the US? What the data shows
english: Tensions in the Strait of Hormuz have divided shipping routes between those controlled by Iran and those protected by the US. Recent maritime data indicates that commercial vessels are increasingly masking their identities to navigate the waterway safely. Many ships appear more cautious about avoiding Iranian interference than they are about defying American naval directives.
amharic: በሆርሙዝ የባህር በር እየተባባሰ የመጣው ውጥረት የባህር ትራፊክን በኢራን እና በአሜሪካ ቁጥጥር ስር ባሉ መስመሮች እንዲከፈል አድርጓል። የቅርብ ጊዜ የባህር ላይ መረጃዎች እንደሚያሳዩት፣ የንግድ መርከቦች በሰላም ለማለፍ ማንነታቸውን ለመደበቅ እየሞከሩ ነው። አብዛኛዎቹ መርከቦች ከአሜሪካ ትዕዛዝ ይልቅ ከኢራን ጣልቃ ገብነት ለመራቅ የበለጠ ጥንቃቄ እያደረጉ ነው።

Markaboonni baay'een isaanii ajaja Ameerikaa irra, tarkaanfii mootummaa Iraan sodaachuun of eeggannoo guddaa gochaa jiru.

title: Israeli shelling targets southern Lebanese towns
english: The Israeli military has launched intensive artillery attacks against several towns and valleys located in southern Lebanon. Local news outlets identified the affected areas as including Wadi al-Salouqi, al-Hujair, Hula, and the regions near Qabrikha and Toulene. These strikes represent an ongoing escalation of tensions in the border region.

title: Explainer: Have European countries been involved in the US-Israeli war on Iran?
english: European nations are facing a difficult balancing act regarding the US-led war in Iran, as they try to avoid direct involvement while managing pressure from Washington. Despite many leaders expressing public disapproval, it has been revealed that European-based military facilities have supported thousands of US combat flights. The United Kingdom, in particular, has become deeply involved by allowing the US to launch airstrikes from its territory and deploying its own military assets in the Middle East.

Keessattuu, Biritaniyaan iddoo waraana Ameerikaan akka fayyadamtu hayyamuufi qabeenya waraana ishee gara Baha Giddu galeessaatti bobbaasuun waraana kana keessatti hirmaannaa guddaa qabaatteetti.

title: France: Mosque closure fuels fear of state overreach on Muslim worship
english: A French administrative court has upheld the six-month closure of the Attaqwa Mosque in Aulnay-sous-Bois, which was shut down by local authorities due to allegations of inciting violence and terrorism. While the government claims the imams promoted hatred and extremist views, many local residents and lawyers are criticizing the move as an unfair restriction on religious freedom. The community is frustrated by the collective punishment of worshippers, arguing that officials should target specific individuals rather than shutting down the entire prayer space.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ ፍርድ ቤት በአውልናይ-ሱ-ቡዋ የሚገኘው አታቅዋ መስጂድ፣ ሁከትን እና ሽብርተኝነትን በማነሳሳት ክስ ለስድስት ወራት እንዲዘጋ የተላለፈውን ውሳኔ አጽንቷል። መንግሥት መስጂዱ ጥላቻን የሚሰብኩ ስብከቶችን ያስተናግዳል ሲል ቢከስም፣ የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች እና ጠበቆች ይህ ውሳኔ ሃይማኖትን የመለማመድ ነፃነትን የሚጥስ ነው ሲሉ ይተቻሉ። ማህበረሰቡም መንግሥት በግለሰቦች ላይ እርምጃ ከመውሰድ ይልቅ የጸሎት ቤቱን መዝጋቱ በአጠቃላይ አማኞች ላይ የሚደረግ ኢ-ፍትሃዊ ቅጣት ነው በማለት ቅሬታቸውን እየገለጹ ነው።
oromo: Mana murtii Faransaayitti, masjiidni Ataa-qwaa jedhamu kan Aulnay-sous-Bois argamu, shororkeessummaa fi jeequmsa kakaasera jechuun baatii jahaaf akka cufamu murteeffamee ture sun jabaatee itti fufeera. title: Max Verstappen signs new F1 contract with Red Bull until 2030
english: Four-time Formula One champion Max Verstappen has extended his partnership with Red Bull Racing through 2030. This new agreement puts an end to ongoing rumors about him potentially leaving the team or retiring from the sport early. Despite facing a difficult season with his current car, Verstappen expressed his commitment to helping the team return to its winning form.

oromo: Injifataan tapha Formula One yeroo afur Max Verstappen, waliigaltee isaa garee Red Bull Racing waliin hanga bara 2030 tti dheereffateera. Garaagarummaan konkolaataa isaa yeroo ammaa isa muudateyyuu, Verstappen garee isaa kana deebisee gara injifannootti fiduuf kutannoo qabaachuu isaa ibseera.

title: Heatwaves and energy crunch: Can Europe withstand a double shock?
english: Europe is currently facing significant economic challenges due to the dual impact of extreme heatwaves and rising energy costs linked to the conflict involving Iran. These environmental conditions are devastating agriculture and reducing productivity, which experts estimate will cost the region roughly 209 billion dollars. This financial strain threatens to erase nearly all of the economic growth projected for the European Union in 2026.
amharic: አውሮፓ በአሁኑ ወቅት በአየር ንብረት መለዋወጥ ሳቢያ በተፈጠረ ከፍተኛ ሙቀት እና ከኢራን ግጭት ጋር በተያያዘ የኃይል ምንጭ ዋጋ መጨመር ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ኢኮኖሚያዊ ችግሮች ገጥመዋታል። ይህ የአየር ሁኔታ በግብርናው ዘርፍ ላይ ጉዳት በማድረስ እና የምርታማነት መጠንን በመቀነስ ወደ 209 ቢሊዮን የአሜሪካ ዶላር የሚገመት የኢኮኖሚ ኪሳራ አስከትሏል። ይህ ከፍተኛ ወጪ የአውሮፓ ህብረት ለፈረንጆቹ 2026 የያዘውን የእድገት እቅድ ሊያከሽፍ እንደሚችል ባለሙያዎች አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Awurooppaan yeroo ammaa kana ho'a cimaa fi gatii anniisaa waraana Iraan waliin walqabatee dabaleen miidhamtee jirti. Ho'i kun qonnaa fi omishtummaa irratti dhiibbaa geessisaa jiruun, biyyootni Awurooppaa tilmaamaan dolaara biliyoona 209 akka dhaban taasiseera. Dhiibbaan diinagdee kun guddina diinagdee Tokkummaa Awurooppaa kan bara 2026 karoorfame guutummaatti akka gufachiisu sodaatamaa jira.

title: Video shows Russian missile strike on Ukrainian capital
english: A Russian ballistic missile attack on Kyiv early Thursday resulted in at least 12 deaths and dozens of injuries. The strikes caused significant damage to civilian areas, specifically hitting a children's hospital. Ukrainian authorities have condemned the targeting of non-military infrastructure.
amharic: ሐሙስ ዕለት በኪየቭ ከተማ በደረሰ የሩሲያ የባለስቲክ ሚሳይል ጥቃት ቢያንስ 12 ሰዎች መሞታቸውና በርካቶች መቁሰላቸው ተነግሯል። ጥቃቱ የህፃናት ሆስፒታልን ጨምሮ በሲቪል ተቋማት ላይ ያነጣጠረ ነበር። የዩክሬን ባለስልጣናት በሲቪል መሠረተ ልማቶች ላይ የተፈጸመውን ይህን ድርጊት አውግዘዋል።
oromo: Guyyaa Kamisaa ganama magaalaa Kiyiivitti haleellaa rookeettii Ruusiyaan raawwattee kanaan namoonni 12 ol yoo du'an, hedduun immoo madaa'aniiru. Haleellaan kun dhaabbilee siviilii fi hospitaala ijoollee irratti kan xiyyeeffate ture. Abbootiin taayitaa Yukreen miidhaa bu'uuraalee misooma siviilii irratti qaqqabe kana balaaleffataniiru.

title: Ben-Gvir celebrates demolition of Palestinian homes in Israel
english: Israeli minister Itamar Ben-Gvir recently expressed support for the destruction of 10,000 Palestinian homes, describing the demolition process in Ramla as a positive event. The Israeli government claims these structures are being removed because they were built without the necessary construction permits. This action has drawn attention to the ongoing tensions and the displacement of Palestinians within Israel.
amharic: የእስራኤል ባለስልጣን ኢታማር ቤን-ግቪር በቅርቡ 10,000 የፍልስጤማውያን መኖሪያ ቤቶች መፍረሳቸውን በመደገፍ በራምላ የተካሄደውን የቤት ማፍረስ ስራ አወድሰዋል። የእስራኤል መንግስት እነዚህ ቤቶች የተፈረሱት ህጋዊ የግንባታ ፈቃድ ስለሌላቸው እንደሆነ ገልጿል። ይህ ድርጊት በእስራኤል ውስጥ የሚኖሩ ፍልስጤማውያንን የመፈናቀል እና ያለውን ውጥረት አባብሶታል።
oromo: Ministirri Israa'eel Itamaar Ben-Gvir ganda Ramlaa keessatti manni jireenyaa Falisxiinotaa 10,000 ol diigamuu isaa gammachuun kan ibsan yoo ta'u, tarkaanficha baay'ee akka jaallatan dubbataniiru. Mootummaan Israa'eel manneen kun kan diigaman hayyama ijaarsaa seera qabeessa waan hin qabneef akka ta'e ibseera. Tarkaanfin kun lafa Falisxiinotaa irratti dhiibbaa fi buqqaatii uumame irratti xiyyeeffannoo guddaa harkiseera.

title: Netanyahu warns Israel will not tolerate Turkish military presence in Syria
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has explicitly stated that his country will not allow Turkish military forces to expand their operations into southern Syria. Following recent Israeli airstrikes on a Syrian military site, Netanyahu confirmed that a formal warning has been issued to Turkey regarding this issue. This move highlights growing tensions over the presence of foreign military powers near Israel's borders.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ የቱርክ ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በሶሪያ ደቡባዊ ክፍል መስፋፋትን ሀገራቸው እንደማትታገስ በግልጽ አስታውቀዋል። በእስራኤል በሶሪያ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ ላይ ከተፈጸመ ጥቃት በኋላ፣ ኔታንያሁ ለቱርክ መንግስት ማስጠንቀቂያ እንደተላለፈ አረጋግጠዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በእስራኤል ድንበር አቅራቢያ ያሉ የውጭ ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች እንቅስቃሴ እየፈጠረ ያለውን ውጥረት ያሳያል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministiraa Israa'el Benyaamiin Netaaniyaahu, waraanni Turkey gara kibba Sooriyaatti akka hin babal'anne biyyi isaanii akka hin hayyamne ibsaniiru. Erga Israa'el buufata waraana Sooriyaa irratti haleellaa raawwattee booda, Netaaniyaahu mootummaan Turkey akeekkachiisa cimaa fudhachuu isaa mirkaneessaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun daangaa Israa'elitti dhihoo jiru irratti waraana biyyoota alaa ilaalchisee yaaddoon jiraachuu isaa kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Oil flows nearly tripled before US-Iran MoU expired, analysis shows
english: Data indicates that oil exports through the Strait of Hormuz nearly tripled during the 60-day period of a recent US-Iran agreement. Despite this temporary increase, overall shipping volumes remained well below historical levels and slowed down significantly toward the end of the deal. The agreement has now expired without a lasting peace settlement, leaving critical shipping routes vulnerable amid ongoing attacks on commercial vessels.
amharic: የቅርብ ጊዜ መረጃዎች እንደሚያሳዩት በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል በተደረሰው የ60 ቀናት ስምምነት ወቅት በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት የሚደረገው የነዳጅ ማጓጓዣ መጠን ወደ ሦስት እጥፍ አድጓል። ምንም እንኳን ይህ ጊዜያዊ ጭማሪ ቢታይም፣ አጠቃላይ የንግድ እንቅስቃሴው ከቀድሞው መጠን ጋር ሲነፃፀር አሁንም ዝቅተኛ እንደሆነ ቀጥሏል። ስምምነቱ ያለ ዘላቂ የሰላም ስምምነት በአሁኑ ጊዜ ስላለቀ፣ ለንግድ መርከቦች በሚሰነዘሩ ጥቃቶች ምክንያት ዋና ዋና የባህር መስመሮች አሁንም ለአደጋ ተጋልጠዋል።
oromo: Odeeffannoon akka agarsiisutti, walii galtee guyyaa 60f Amerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti godhame kanaan, gabaan boba’aa karaa Hormuz dabru yeroo sadiin guddachuu danda’eera. Guddinni kun kan ture ta’us, gabaan waliigalaa sadarkaa durii irraa gadi bu’aadha. Walii galichi furmaata nagaa waaraa tokko malee waan xumurameef, karaaleen gurguddoon daldalaa har’as haleellaa dooniiwwan daldalaa irraa kan ka’e balaaf saaxilamanii jiru.

title: Mushroom killer must stay in jail forever for 'truly dreadful' crime, appeal court told
english: Australian prosecutors are arguing that Erin Patterson, who was convicted of murdering three relatives using poisonous mushrooms, should receive a life sentence without the possibility of parole. The legal teams described her actions as a calculated betrayal of trust, noting that she fed her guests deadly meals while lying about her own health. While the prosecution seeks a harsher punishment, Patterson's defense is simultaneously attempting to overturn her initial conviction.
amharic: መርዛማ እንጉዳይ በመጠቀም ሶስት ዘመዶቿን የገደለችው ኤሪን ፓተርሰን፣ ከእስር የመውጣት እድል ሳይኖራት በዕድሜ ልክ እስራት እንድትቀጣ አቃቤ ህግ እየጠየቀ ነው። ባለሥልጣናቱ ወንጀሏ የተፈጸመው በታቀደ እቅድ እና በአሰቃቂ ክህደት እንደሆነ በመግለጽ ቅጣቱ ቀላል እንደሆነ ይከራከራሉ። በሌላ በኩል፣ የፓተርሰን ጠበቆች ጥፋተኛ የተባለችበትን ውሳኔ ለመሻር ይግባኝ ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Erin Patterson, dubartii firashee sadii kottee summii (mushroom) fayyadamuun ajjeeste, hidhaa bara baraan fi carraa gadi lakkifamu malee akka adabamtu abbaan alangaa gaafataa jira. Gochi kun gantummaa fi karooraan kan raawwatame waan ta'eef, adabbiin ishee amma jiru baay'ee xiqqaa dha jedhamee amanama. Gama biraatiin, abukaatonni Patterson murtee ishee irratti darbe kana jijjiirsisuuf ol-iyyannoo dhiyeessanii jiru.

title: Top seeds Sabalenka, Zverev knocked out of Cincinnati Open
english: Top tennis seeds Aryna Sabalenka and Alexander Zverev were both unexpectedly eliminated during the fourth round of the Cincinnati Open. Sara Bejlek achieved a major upset by defeating the world number one, Sabalenka, in straight sets. Meanwhile, American Tommy Paul overcame a tough challenge and rain delays to knock out French Open champion Zverev. These results serve as a significant disappointment for both stars as they prepare for the upcoming US Open.
amharic: የዓለም ቁጥር አንድ ተጫዋች አሪና ሳባሌንካ እና የፈረንሳይ ኦፕን ሻምፒዮኑ አሌክሳንደር ዝቬሬቭ በሲንሲናቲ ኦፕን ቴኒስ ውድድር አራተኛ ዙር अप्रत्याशित በሆነ መልኩ ተሸንፈው ከውድድሩ ውጪ ሆነዋል። ሳራ ቤሌክ የዓለም አንደኛዋን ሳባሌንካን በማሸነፍ ትልቅ ድንቆን ስታስመዘግብ፣ ቶሚ ፖል ደግሞ በዝናብ የታጀበውን ጨዋታ በማሸነፍ ዝቬሬቭን አሰናብቷል። ይህ ውጤት ሁለቱንም ታላላቅ ተጫዋቾች በቅርቡ ለሚጀመረው የዩኤስ ኦፕን ውድድር ዝግጅታቸው ላይ ከፍተኛ ጫና ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Taphattoonni gurguddoon Aryna Sabalenka fi Alexander Zverev dorgommii Cincinnati Open irratti sadarkaa afuraffaatti tasa mo'atamanii bahaniiru. Sara Bejlek, sadarkaa tokkoffaa addunyaa kan taate Sabalenka mo'achuudhaan dinqisiisaa guddaa uumteetti. Gam biraatiin, Tommy Paul obsaa fi jijjiirama haala qilleensaa kessatti taphatee Zverev injifateera. Bu'aan kun taphattoota lamaanifuu dorgommii US Open dhiyootti eegalamuuf qophiin isaan godhan miidheera.

title: Over 200,000 people newly displaced in Sudan’s Kordofan as fighting rages
english: Escalating conflict in Sudan's Kordofan region has forced over 200,000 people to flee their homes since the end of last year. Persistent attacks on vital infrastructure, including power and water systems in El Obeid, have severely worsened the humanitarian situation. These displacements are compounded by recent heavy flooding in other areas, leaving millions of Sudanese in urgent need of humanitarian aid.
amharic: በሱዳን ኮርዶፋን ክልል እየተባባሰ በመጣው ግጭት ምክንያት ከባለፈው ዓመት መጨረሻ ጀምሮ ከ200,000 በላይ የሚሆኑ ነዋሪዎች ከቀያቸው ተፈናቅለዋል። በኤል ኦቤድ ከተማ በሚገኙ የኤሌክትሪክ እና የውኃ መሰረተ ልማቶች ላይ እየደረሰ ያለው ጥቃት የሰብአዊ ቀውሱን ይበልጥ አባብሶታል። በሌሎች አካባቢዎች የተከሰተው ጎርፍም ችግሩን በማወሳሰብ በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ የሱዳን ዜጎች አስቸኳይ የሰብአዊ ዕርዳታ እንዲያስፈልጋቸው አድርጓል።
oromo: Gogggoggessa biyya Sudaan godina Kordofanitti adeemaa jiruun wal qabatee, namoonni 200,000 ol ta'an dhuma waggaa darbee kaasee qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqa'aniiru. Magaala El Obeiditti bu'uuraalee misoomaa akka humna ibsaa fi bishaanii irratti haleellaan gaggeeffamuun haala namoomaa yeroodhaa gara yerootti akka hammaatu taasiseera. Rakkoo kanaan alatti, lolaan naannolee biroo mudate rakkoo kana caalaatti hammaachiisee, lammiileen Sudaan miliyoonaan lakkaa'aman gargaarsa hatattamaa akka barbaadan taasiseera.

title: Lionel Messi scores first goal for Inter Miami since father’s death
english: Lionel Messi scored his first goal for Inter Miami following the recent passing of his father, Jorge Messi. During the match against the Philadelphia Union, which ended in a 2-2 draw, the star forward paid tribute by gesturing toward the sky after his goal. Despite his efforts, Inter Miami has struggled recently and is currently on a four-game winless streak.

title: Bangladesh holds presidential election in first contested vote in 35 years
english: Bangladesh is conducting its first competitive presidential election in 35 years following the resignation of the previous president. The ruling party's candidate, Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir, faces opposition nominee Oli Ahmed in a vote held by the country's lawmakers. Although the ruling party holds a strong numerical advantage that makes the outcome predictable, the event marks a significant symbolic step in the nation's democratic recovery.

oromo: Bangladesh erga pirezidaantiin duraanii aangoo gadhiisanii booda, waggoota 35 keessatti yeroo jalqabaaf filannoo pirezidaantummaa morkii qabu geggeessaa jirti. Kaadhimamaan paartii biyya bulchu Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir fi kaadhimamaan mormitootaa Oli Ahmed miseensota mana maree biyyattii gidduutti wal dorgomu. Giddu galeessaan paartiin biyya bulchu harka caalu qabaachuun isaa bu'aan filannichaa akka beekamu kan taasisu ta'us, filannoon kun deebi'ee dhaabbachuu dimokraasii biyyattii keessatti tarkaanfii fakkeenya ta'e dha.

title: After Gaza, can Muslims defend Al-Aqsa Mosque?
english: Concerns are growing that the Al-Aqsa Mosque faces a serious risk of structural and administrative changes as discussions about altering the site gain traction in Israeli politics. The article questions whether the global Muslim community can effectively protect the site, noting that past responses to the humanitarian crisis in Gaza have been largely ineffective. Ultimately, the author urges Muslims to reflect on whether their personal comforts and priorities have hindered their ability to mobilize and act decisively in defense of their religious sites.

Rakkoon Gaza keessatti mul’ate akka agarsiisutti, hawaasni Muslimaa addunyaa rakkoo akkasii irratti tarkaanfii qabatamaa fudhachuu irratti dadhabina qaba. Barreessaan kun, Muslimoonni mudannoo Gaza irraa barachuun, faayidaa fi tasgabbii dhuunfaa isaanii aarsaa gochuun bakka amantii isaanii kana ittisuuf walta'uun socho'uu akka qaban gaafata.

title: Iran's Araghchi says Trump's 'Economic D-Day' is a diversion from US domestic problems
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi dismissed Donald Trump's threat of severe economic warfare, labeling it a distraction from the United States' own internal financial crises. Araghchi argued that these aggressive policies are unsuccessful and will only increase opposition from the Iranian people. He further warned that such actions undermine global stability and threaten the sovereignty of nations worldwide.

oromo: Ministirri Dhimmi Alaa Iraan Abbas Araghchi, Donald Trump, Iraan irratti duula diinagdee cimaa banuuf sodaachisuu isaanii kan balaaleffatan yoo ta'u, kunis rakkoo diinagdee Amerikaa keessoo dhoksuuf kan yaalame dha jedhan. title: Israeli opposition leader and former prime minister criticise Netanyahu over Syria attacks
english: Israeli opposition figures Yair Golan and Ehud Barak have strongly criticized Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for a recent military strike in Syria. They argue that the attack was a reckless political move that threatens Israel's relationship with Turkey and undermines national security. The critics claim Netanyahu is prioritizing his own political survival over regional stability, calling for more responsible leadership.

title: Israeli defence minister warns Turkey against 'threatening its security'
english: Israel's defense minister, Israel Katz, has issued a sharp warning to Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan regarding his recent foreign policy actions in Syria. Katz cautioned that Turkey is heading toward dangerous territory and insisted that Israel will not tolerate any threats to its national safety. He suggested that Erdogan should focus on his political rhetoric at home rather than challenging Israel's resolve to defend itself.

title: Australian anger as Israel drops World Central Kitchen deaths case
english: The Australian government has formally protested Israel’s decision to close the criminal investigation into the 2024 Gaza airstrike that killed seven World Central Kitchen aid workers, including an Australian citizen. Canberra expressed deep frustration and summoned the Israeli ambassador to voice their disapproval of this outcome. This move follows widespread global criticism regarding the lack of accountability for the tragedy.

oromo: Mootummaan Awustiraaliyaa, bara 2024 Gaazaatti hojjettoota dhaabbata gargaarsaa 'World Central Kitchen' torba irratti xiyyaaraan haleellaa gaggeeffameen lubbuun isaanii darbuu hordofee, Israa'el qorannoo yakkaa cufuushee balaaleffatteetti. Namoota du'an keessaa lammiin Awustiraaliyaa tokko kan argaman yoo ta'u, mootummaan Awustiraaliyaa ambaasaaddara Israa'el waamuudhaan mufii cimaa qaban ibsaniiru. Murteen yakka irratti himata akka hin banne Israa'el murteessite kun, sadarkaa idil-addunyaatti gaddi guddaan akka uumamu taasiseera.

title: Founder of collapsed Chinese property giant Evergrande sentenced to life in prison
english: Hui Ka Yan, the founder of the massive Chinese real estate firm Evergrande, has been sentenced to life in prison following his conviction for embezzlement and bribery. The company, which once led China's property market, collapsed in 2021 after years of aggressive borrowing and the misuse of funds intended for home construction. In addition to his prison term, Hui faces the total seizure of his personal assets, while the company has been ordered to pay significant fines for its role in the industry's economic downturn.
amharic: የቻይናው ትልቅ የሪል እስቴት ኩባንያ ኤቨርግራንዴ መስራች ሁይ ካ ያን፣ በሙስና እና በገንዘብ ማጭበርበር ወንጀል ጥፋተኛ ሆነው በመገኘታቸው የዕድሜ ልክ እስራት ተፈርዶባቸዋል። ኩባንያው ከልክ በላይ በተበደረው ብድር እና ለቤት ግንባታ የተሰበሰበውን ገንዘብ ለሌላ ዓላማ በማዋሉ በ2021 ከፍተኛ ውድቀት ገጥሞት ነበር። ከእስራት ቅጣቱ በተጨማሪ፣ የሁይ የግል ንብረቶች በሙሉ እንዲወረሱ የተደረገ ሲሆን ኩባንያውም በፈጠረው ኢኮኖሚያዊ ቀውስ ምክንያት ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ቅጣት ተጥሎበታል።
oromo: Hundeesituun dhaabbata gurguddaa qabeenya lafaa Chaayinaa kan ta'e Evergrande, Hui Ka Yan, yakka maallaqa hatuu fi malaammaltummaan himatamee hidhaa cimaa umrii guutuu itti murtaa'eera. Dhaabbatichi waggoota dheeraaf liqii garmalee fudhachuu fi maallaqa ijaarsa manaaif qabame gara birootti dabarsuun erga miidhamee booda bara 2021 guutummaatti kufaatii keessa gale. Murtee hidhaa kana cinaatti, qabeenyii dhuunfaa isaa guututti kan mootummaatti fudhatamu yoo ta'u, dhaabbatichis miidhaa diinagdee geessiseef adabbii maallaqa guddaa akka kaffalu ajajameera.

title: Exclusive: Pentagon sends ‘political loyalty’ survey to US allies
english: The Pentagon has issued a questionnaire to 31 NATO member nations to assess their political loyalty toward the United States. This unusual move highlights a shift in diplomatic approach, prioritizing firm allegiance to the current administration. Experts suggest this strategy aligns with President Trump’s emphasis on personal and national loyalty in international relations.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መከላከያ ሚኒስቴር ለ31 የኔቶ አባል ሀገራት ለዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ያላቸውን ታማኝነት ለመፈተሽ መጠይቅ ልኳል። ይህ ያልተለመደ እርምጃ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነቶችን እንደገና በመገምገም በዋናነት ለወቅታዊው አስተዳደር ያላቸውን አቋም ለማወቅ ያለመ ነው። ተንታኞች ይህ አካሄድ በፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የውጭ ግንኙነት ፖሊሲ ውስጥ ለታማኝነት የሚሰጠውን ከፍተኛ ትኩረት የሚያሳይ ነው ብለው ያምናሉ።
oromo: Ministeerri ittisa biyyaa Ameerikaa (Pentagon) biyyoota miseensa NATO ta'an 31f gaaffilee biyyi isaanii Ameerikaaf amanamummaa qabdu ilaalu ergeera. Tarkaanfiin kun haala dipiloomaasii durii jijjiiruu danda'uufi mootummaa amma jiruuf qofa irratti kan xiyyeeffatu dha. Hayyoonni akka jedhanitti, tooftaan kun fedhii Pirezidaant Traamp kan siyaasa alaatiin amanamummaa akkaataa itti barbaadan kan ibsuudha.

title: At least 6 killed in multiple Russian missile strikes across Ukraine
english: Russian ballistic missiles targeted Ukraine's capital city early Thursday, resulting in at least six fatalities and over twenty-four injuries. The attacks caused widespread fires after hitting residential areas and a medical facility for children. Authorities are currently managing the aftermath of this significant escalation in urban strikes.
amharic: በዩክሬን ዋና ከተማ ኪቭ በተፈጸመ የሩሲያ የባሊስቲክ ሚሳኤል ጥቃት ቢያንስ ስድስት ሰዎች ሲሞቱ ከሃያ አራት በላይ የሚሆኑት ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቶቹ የመኖሪያ ሕንፃዎችን እና የሕፃናት ሆስፒታልን በመምታታቸው በበርካታ ቦታዎች እሳት ተቀስቅሷል። የአገሪቱ ባለስልጣናት በአስከፊው የከተማ ጥቃት የደረሰውን ጉዳት ለመቆጣጠር እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Halkan har'aa magaala guddittii Yukreen, Kiyiv irratti rooba boombii Raashiyaan gaggeessiteen namoonni ja'a ajjeefamanii, namoonni digdamaa ol ta'an immoo miidhamaniiru. Miisayilonni kunneen manneen jireenyaa fi hospitaala ijoollee irratti waan caccabaniif, magaalattii keessatti ibiddaan manca'iinsi guddaan ga'eera. Aangeyyoonni biyyattii miidhaa weerara kanaa tasgabbeessuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru.

title: Russia launches missile strikes on Kyiv and surrounding region, killing at least eight
english: Russian forces conducted a major missile attack on Kyiv and its surrounding areas, resulting in at least eight deaths and over thirty injuries. The strikes damaged civilian infrastructure including apartment buildings, a children's hospital, and warehouses, while also causing widespread power outages. Additionally, authorities in neighboring Romania and Poland reported air security concerns after a drone entered Romanian territory and military defenses were activated in Poland.
amharic: የሩሲያ ኃይሎች በኪየቭ እና በአካባቢዋ ባደረሱት ከፍተኛ የሚሳኤል ጥቃት ቢያንስ ስምንት ሰዎች መሞታቸውና ከሰላሳ በላይ የሚሆኑት መቁሰላቸው ተነግሯል። ጥቃቱ የመኖሪያ ሕንጻዎችን፣ የሕፃናት ሆስፒታልንና መጋዘኖችን በመምታቱ ሰፊ የሆነ የኤሌክትሪክ መቆራረጥ አስከትሏል። በተጨማሪም፣ በአጎራባች ሮማኒያ የአየር ክልል ውስጥ ድሮን መግባቱና በፖላንድም የመከላከያ ሥራዎች መጀመራቸው ተገልጿል።
oromo: Humnoonni Raashiyaa magaalaa Kiyiv fi naannawa ishee irratti haleellaa misaa'elaa cimaa gaggeessaniin, namoonni yoo xiqqaate saddeet du'anii fi namoonni soddomii ol ta'an miidhamaniiru. Haleellaan kun manneen jireenyaa, hospitaala daa'immanii fi bakkee gabaa miidhuun, humna ibsaa guutummaatti kutuu danda'eera. Kana malees, biyyoonni ollaa Raashiyaa kan ta'an Roomeeniyaa fi Poolaandi, xiyyaara malee to'annoo ala (drone) fi nageenya qilleensa isaanii irratti sodaa uumame hordofee tarkaanfii irra turaniiru.

title: Trump vows ‘economic warfare’ on countries helping Iran
english: Former President Donald Trump has threatened to impose severe economic consequences on any nations that continue to conduct business with Iran. This strategy marks a shift toward using financial pressure rather than direct military force to isolate the Iranian government. While the specific details of these measures remain unclear, the announcement indicates a heightened focus on global economic warfare as a tool of foreign policy.
amharic: ቀድሞ የነበሩት የአሜሪካ ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከኢራን ጋር የንግድ ግንኙነት የሚያደርጉ ሀገራት ላይ ጠንካራ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ እንደሚጥሉ አስፈራርተዋል። ይህ አካሄድ ወታደራዊ ኃይል ከመጠቀም ይልቅ በኢኮኖሚ ጫና አማካኝነት የኢራንን መንግስት ለማግለል ያለመ ነው። ምንም እንኳን የዚህ እቅድ ዝርዝር መረጃዎች ገና ባይገለጹም፣ እርምጃው በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ የኢኮኖሚ ጦርነትን እንደ ዋና የውጭ ግንኙነት መሳሪያ ለመጠቀም ያለውን ፍላጎት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Pirezedaantiin duraanii Donald Tiraamp biyyoota Iran waliin daldala godhan hunda irratti tarkaanfii dinagdee cimaa fudhachuu akka danda'an akeekkachiisaniiru. Karoorri kun humna waraanaa fayyadamuurra, dhiibbaa dinagdeetiin mootummaa Iran adda baasuuf kan kaayyeffate dha. Hanga ammaa haalli tarkaanfii kanaa ifa bahee kan hin jirre ta'us, ibsi kun waraana dinagdee akka meeshaa siyaasaa alatti fayyadamuuf fedhii guddaa akka jiru agarsiisa.

title: Oil supertankers in Gulf are renting for $500,000 per day: Report
english: The daily rental cost for supertankers transporting crude oil from the Persian Gulf to Asia has surged to over $500,000. This sharp increase reflects a high demand for shipping vessels despite the ongoing risks posed by regional military conflicts. Some operators are choosing to navigate these dangerous waters to secure significant profits as global energy supply chains face disruptions.
amharic: ከፋርስ ባህረ ሰላጤ ወደ እስያ ድፍድፍ ነዳጅ የሚያጓጉዙ ግዙፍ የነዳጅ መርከቦች የቀን ኪራይ ዋጋ ከ500,000 ዶላር በላይ ደርሷል። ይህ ከፍተኛ የዋጋ ጭማሪ በክልሉ ባለው ግጭት ምክንያት በነዳጅ ማጓጓዣ መርከቦች ላይ ያለው ፍላጎት መጨመሩን ያሳያል። አንዳንድ መርከብ አቅራቢዎች አደጋውን ተቋቁመው ትርፍ ለማግኘት ወደ እነዚህ አደገኛ የባህር መስመሮች መጓዛቸውን ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Gatiin kireeffannaa guyyaatti dooniiwwan gurguddoo boba'aa (supertankers) gabaa Gandaa (Persian Gulf) irraa gara Eeshiyaatti boba'aa geessan $500,000 ol ga'eera. Daballii gatii kanaa kan argisiisu, naannichatti waraanni jiraatus fedhiin dooniiwwan geejjibaa daran dabaluu isaa dha. Daldaltoonni tokko tokko immoo rakkoo jiruus osoo hin hirdhin, bu'aa guddaa argachuuf jecha balaa keessa darbuu filachaa jiru.

title: Former Liberian vice president charged in drug-trafficking probe
english: Liberian authorities have arrested former Vice President Jewel Howard-Taylor at the airport, charging her with involvement in drug trafficking and money laundering. These allegations are part of a broader government effort to dismantle illegal narcotics networks and curb the rise of regional cocaine smuggling. Three foreign nationals are also linked to this case, as current leadership seeks to address long-standing corruption and stop the nation from becoming a hub for international drug crime.
amharic: የሊቤሪያ ባለስልጣናት የቀድሞዋን ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጁዌል ሃዋርድ-ቴይለር በአደንዛዥ ዕፅ ዝውውር እና በገንዘብ ማጭበርበር ወንጀል ተጠርጥረው በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋቸዋል። ይህም እርምጃ መንግስት በአገሪቱ እየተስፋፋ የመጣውን ህገ-ወጥ የአደንዛዥ ዕፅ ንግድ ለመቆጣጠር ከሚወስደው አጠቃላይ እርምጃ አካል ነው። ከዚህ ወንጀል ጋር በተያያዘ ሶስት የውጭ ዜጎችም ተጠርጥረው ክስ የቀረበባቸው ሲሆን፣ የአገሪቱ አመራር በስልጣን ላይ የነበረውን ሙስና ለመዋጋት ጥረት እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Mootummaan Laayibeeriyaa dura taa'aa biyyattii kan turan Juweel Haaward-Teyler, yakka gurgurtaa qoricha sammuu namaa hadoochuu fi seeraan alaa qabeenya walitti qabachuu shakkamee buufata xiyyaaraa irratti qabamaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun mootummaan biyyattii sharafa qoricha sammuu namaa to'achuufi yakka kana dhaabsisuuf godhaa jiru keessaa isa tokko. Dhimma kana wajjin walqabatee namoonni biyyoota alaa sadii irrattis himannaan kan baname yoo ta'u, hoogganoonni ammaa guddina shakkii yakkaafi malaammaltummaa biyyattii keessatti bal'ate ittisuuf hojjachaa jiru.

title: Russian strike kills 3 in Ukraine as Zelenskyy faces pressure at home
english: A Russian ballistic missile attack on Kyiv killed three people and injured at least 20, causing significant damage to residential buildings and a children's hospital. The strike occurred as President Zelenskyy manages internal political shifts, including the recent appointment of a new defense minister. Local officials have reported widespread power outages and ongoing rescue efforts as the country continues to deal with both enemy fire and domestic leadership changes.
amharic: ሩሲያ በኪየቭ ላይ በፈጸመችው የባሊስቲክ ሚሳኤል ጥቃት ቢያንስ ሶስት ሰዎች ሲሞቱ 20 ሰዎች ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቱ የመኖሪያ ሕንፃዎችን እና የህጻናት ሆስፒታልን በመጉዳቱ በከተማዋ የኤሌክትሪክ አገልግሎት መቋረጡ ተገልጿል። ይህ ጥቃት የተፈጸመው ፕሬዚዳንት ዘለንስኪ አዲሱን የመከላከያ ሚኒስትር በመሾም የውስጥ የፖለቲካ ጫናዎችን ለመቋቋም በሚጥሩበት ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Rusiyan magaalaa Kiyiv irratti haleellaa misa'elaa gaggeessiteen namoonni sadii du'anii, 20 ol ammoo miidhamaniiru. Haleellaan kun manneen jireenyaa fi hospitaala ijoollee irratti miidhaa geessisuun isaa kan himame yoo ta'u, bakkeewwan tokko tokkotti humna ibsaa akka addaan citu taasiseera. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame yeroo Prezidaanti Zelenski ministira ittisa biyyaa haaraa muudanii fi dhiibbaa siyaasaa keessoo biyyattii keessatti mudate furuuf carraaqaa jiranitti.

title: Shaibani's arrival in Pakistan marks first Syrian diplomatic visit in nearly two decades
english: Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad Al-Shaibani has arrived in Pakistan, marking the first visit by a top-level Syrian official in 19 years. He is leading a high-ranking delegation to Islamabad to discuss diplomatic relations. This visit signals a significant warming of ties between the two nations after nearly two decades of limited interaction.
amharic: የሶሪያው የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አሳድ አል-ሻይባኒ ወደ ፓኪስታን በማቅናት በ19 ዓመታት ውስጥ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ከፍተኛ የሶሪያ ዲፕሎማት ጉብኝት አድርገዋል። ሚኒስትሩ ከከፍተኛ የልዑካን ቡድን ጋር በመሆን ኢስላማባድ የገቡ ሲሆን፣ ይህም በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ለረጅም ጊዜ ተቋርጦ የነበረውን ግንኙነት እንደገና ለማጠናከር ያለመ ነው። ይህ ጉብኝት በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ያለውን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት እንደ አዲስ የሚጀምር ተደርጎ ታይቷል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimmi Alaa Siiriyaa Asaad Al-Shaibani gara Paakistaan imaluun, waggoota 19 keessatti biyyattii kan daawwatan jalqabaa ta'aniiru. Ministirichi garee sadarkaa olaanaa qabu waliin magaalaa Isilaamaabaad kan ga'an yoo ta'u, kunis hariiroo biyyoota lamaanii fooyyessuuf kan gargaaruudha. Daawwannan kun hariiroo diploomaasii waggoota dheeraaf gadi bu'aa ture deebisanii cimsuuf kan karoorfameedha.

title: Traffic through Hormuz Strait shows no rise, data suggests
english: Recent data from Kpler indicates that shipping activity through the Strait of Hormuz has remained stable. Only nine vessels crossed the vital maritime route on Wednesday, matching the previous day's numbers. These figures show that there has been no increase in traffic despite the region's strategic importance.
amharic: የኬፕለር መረጃ እንደሚያሳየው በሆርሙዝ የባህር በር የሚያልፉ መርከቦች እንቅስቃሴ የተረጋጋ ነው። ባለፈው ረቡዕ በዚሁ ወሳኝ የባህር መስመር ዘጠኝ መርከቦች ብቻ ያለፉ ሲሆን ይህም ከቀዳሚው ቀን ጋር ተመሳሳይ ነው። ምንም እንኳን አካባቢው ስትራቴጂካዊ ጠቀሜታ ቢኖረውም በትራፊክ ፍሰቱ ላይ ምንም አይነት ጭማሪ አልታየም።
oromo: Odeeffannoon Kpler akka agarsiisutti, imalli dooniiwwan handhuura Hormuz irra darban jijjiirama tokkollee hin agarsiifne. Guyyaa Roobii darbe dooniiwwan sagal qofatu karaa kana irra darbe; kunis lakkoofsa guyyaa isa duraa wajjin wal qixa. Naannichi bakka tarsiimoo cimaa ta'us, imalli dooniiwwan dabaluu isaa odeeffannoon kun ni haala.

title: Hind Rajab's grandmother rejects Israeli army probe into killing, calls for independent international investigation: Report
english: The grandmother of five-year-old Hind Rajab has dismissed the Israeli military's internal investigation into the girl's death. She stated that her family does not trust the Israeli legal system and is calling for an independent international probe instead. This demand extends beyond Hind's case to include justice for all children killed during the ongoing conflict in Gaza.
amharic: የአምስት ዓመቷ ሂንድ ራጃብ አያት የእስራኤል ጦር የልጅ ልጇን መገደል አስመልክቶ ያካሄደውን ምርመራ ተቀባይነት እንደሌለው ገለጹ። ቤተሰቧ በእስራኤል የፍትህ ስርዓት ላይ እምነት እንደሌላቸው በመግለጽ፣ ጉዳዩ በገለልተኛ ዓለም አቀፍ አካል እንዲጣራ ጠይቀዋል። አያቷ ይህ ጥያቄ የሂንድን ብቻ ሳይሆን በጋዛ ለተገደሉ ህጻናት ሁሉ ፍትህ ለማግኘት መሆኑን አስረድተዋል።
oromo: Maatiin ijoollee waggaa shan Hind Raajab, qorannoon waraanni Israa'el du'a ijoollee ishii irratti gaggeesse fudhatama hin qabu jedhaniiru. Maatiin sun sirna haqaa Israa'el irratti amantii akka hin qabne ibsuun, qorannoon kun qaama idil-addunyaa walaba ta'een akka gaggeeffamu gaafataniiru. Gaaffiin kun du'a Hind qofaaf osoo hin taane, ijoollee gaza keessatti ajjeefaman hundaaf haqni akka argamuuf kan ka'e dha.

title: Giant whales move into Greenland waters as ice disappears
english: Rising sea temperatures have caused Arctic ice to melt, opening new areas for giant whales like humpbacks, fin, and minke to enter the coastal waters of East Greenland. Researchers note that these whales are now gathering in large numbers during the summer to feed on fish populations that have also moved into the region. This significant ecological shift, which was rare or non-existent in the past, highlights how climate change is rapidly altering marine habitats.
amharic: የባህር ሙቀት መጨመር በሰሜን ዋልታ አካባቢ ያለው በረዶ እንዲቀልጥ በማድረጉ፣ እንደ ሀምፕባክ፣ ፊን እና ሚንኬ ያሉ ግዙፍ ዓሣ ነባሪዎች ወደ ምስራቅ ግሪንላንድ የባህር ዳርቻዎች እንዲገቡ አስችሏቸዋል። ተመራማሪዎች እንደሚሉት፣ እነዚህ ዓሣ ነባሪዎች በበጋ ወራት ወደ አካባቢው በመምጣት ወደዚያ በተሰደዱ የዓሣ ዝርያዎች ላይ ለመመገብ ይሰበሰባሉ። ይህ ከዚህ ቀደም የማይታይ እና ትልቅ ሥነ-ምህዳራዊ ለውጥ፣ የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ በባህር ውስጥ ያሉ መኖሪያዎችን እንዴት በፍጥነት እየለወጠ እንደሆነ ያሳያል።
oromo: Ho'i galaanaa dabaluun qorrisuu baddaa Arctic irraa ka'uun, whale ykn leemman gurguddoon akka humpback, fin fi minke gara qarqara galaana Greenland bahaa akka seenan godheera. Qorattoonni akka ibsanitti, leemman kunniin gannaa gara naannichaa dhufuun qurxummii achitti argaman sooratu. Jijjiiramni gurguddaan kun, kan dur hin beekamne, jijjiiramni qilleensaa iddoo jireenyaa bishaan keessaa akkamitti hatattamaan jijjiiraa akka jiru agarsiisa.

title: Fears grow in Amazon village as Brazilian drug gangs push into Bolivia
english: Residents of a remote Bolivian village near the Amazon River are feeling increasingly unsafe due to violence from Brazilian drug cartels. These criminal groups are competing for control over regional trafficking corridors, leading to physical attacks on the local population. In response to the rising instability, the government has deployed security forces to the town of Guayaramerin to restore order and protect the residents.
amharic: በአማዞን ወንዝ አቅራቢያ በምትገኝ የቦሊቪያ መንደር የሚኖሩ ነዋሪዎች ከብራዚል የመጡ የአደንዛዥ ዕፅ ወንጀለኛ ቡድኖች በሚፈጥሩት ግጭት ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ስጋት ውስጥ ናቸው። እነዚህ ቡድኖች አደንዛዥ ዕፅን ለማዘዋወር በሚያደርጉት ፍልሚያ በአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ላይ ጥቃት እየፈጸሙ ይገኛሉ። ሁኔታውን ለመቆጣጠር እና የህዝቡን ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ መንግስት ወደ ጉያራሜሪን ከተማ የጸጥታ ሃይሎችን ልኳል።
oromo: Gandoota biyya Booliiviyaa kan laga Amaazoon biratti argaman keessa jiraattonni, gareewwan yakka gurgurtaa qoricha sammuu namaa adoochan kan Biraazil irraa dhufan uumaa jiran sodaa keessa galaniiru. Gareewwan kunneen daandiiwwan seeraan alaa to'achuuf wal lolachaa waan jiraniif, jiraattota irratti miidhaan geessifamaa jira. Mootummaan rakkoo nageenyaa kana furuufi nageenya uummataas eeguuf humni nageenyaa magaala Guayaramerinitti bobbaafameera.

title: Trump threatens 'tremendous economic consequences' on any country helping Iran
english: President Donald Trump has announced plans to impose severe economic sanctions on any nation that continues to trade with or support Iran. This warning comes after a temporary ceasefire ended without a resolution, prompting the US to escalate its financial pressure. Trump specifically demanded an immediate halt to all oil smuggling and financial assistance, though he did not outline the exact nature of the threatened penalties.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከኢራን ጋር የንግድ ግንኙነት የሚያደርጉ ወይም የሚደግፉ ሀገራት ላይ ከፍተኛ የሆነ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ እንደሚጥሉ አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ማስጠንቀቂያ የተሰጠው በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል የነበረው የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ያለ ምንም መፍትሄ መጠናቀቁን ተከትሎ ነው። ትራምፕ የነዳጅ ንግድን እና የገንዘብ ዝውውሮችን ጨምሮ ኢራንን የሚረዱ ማናቸውም ድርጊቶች በአስቸኳይ እንዲቆሙ ያዘዙ ሲሆን፣ ተገዢ ያልሆኑ ሀገራት ላይ ምን አይነት እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ ግን በግልጽ አልተናገሩም።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Doonaald Tiraamp biyyoota Iraan gargaaran ykn ishee waliin daldalan hundarratti tarkaanfii dinagdee cimaa fudhachuuf akka jiran beeksisaniiru. Labsii kana kan baasan waldhabdee biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru furuuf dhaabbannii waraanaa duraan ture erga xumuramee boodadha. Tiraamp gurgurtaa boba'aa fi daddabarsaa maallaqaa dabalatee gargaarsi Iraaniif godhamu hundi hatattamaan akka dhaabbatu kan gaafatan yoo ta'u, biyyoota seera kana cabsanirratti maaltu akka mudatu garuu ifa hin taasisne.

title: Alarm in South Korea as Iran dispute with Trump shakes a 72-year alliance
english: President Trump recently ordered a significant reduction in joint military exercises with South Korea, citing Seoul’s refusal to participate in the ongoing US-Israel conflict with Iran. This unexpected decision has unsettled the South Korean government and reignited concerns regarding the long-term reliability of US security guarantees. As a result, South Korean leaders are now discussing the need to prioritize domestic military independence while navigating these strained diplomatic ties.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በቅርቡ ከኢራን ጋር እየተካሄደ ባለው ግጭት ደቡብ ኮሪያ ላለመሳተፍ በመወሰኗ፣ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል የሚደረገውን የጋራ ወታደራዊ ልምምድ እንዲቀንስ አዘዋል። ይህ ያልተጠበቀ ውሳኔ የደቡብ ኮሪያን መንግስት ያሳሰበ ሲሆን፣ በአሜሪካ የጸጥታ ዋስትና ላይ ያለውን እምነት ጥያቄ ውስጥ አስገብቶታል። በመሆኑም የደቡብ ኮሪያ መሪዎች ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነቱን ለማስተካከል እየጣሩ፣ ለሀገሪቱ የራሷ ወታደራዊ አቅም ግንባታ ትኩረት መስጠት እንደሚገባቸው እየተወያዩ ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaant Traamp dhiheenya kana biyyi Koriyaa Kibbaa waraana Ameerikaafi Israa'el kan Iiraan waliin jiru keessatti hirmaachuu diduun ishee, leenjii waraanaa wajjiin godhamu akka gadi hir'isu ajajaniiru. Murtii tasaa ta'e kana hordofee mootummaan Koriyaa Kibbaa yaaddoo keessa kan gale yoo ta'u, waadaa nageenyaa Ameerikaa irraa argatan amanummaa isaa irratti shakkii uumeera. Kana irraa kan ka'e, hoggantoonni Koriyaa Kibbaa hariiroo diippiloomaasii isaanii tasgabbeessaa, of danda'anii of ittisuuf xiyyeeffannoo kennuun barbaachisaa ta'uu irratti mari'achaa jiru.

title: Bodycam captures police team falling when deck collapses in Missouri
english: A group of law enforcement officers in Huntsville, Missouri, were injured when a deck collapsed beneath them during a warrant operation. Body camera footage captured the moment the structure gave way while members of the Moberly Area SWAT team and US Marshals were conducting their duties. Thankfully, authorities are addressing the aftermath of this unexpected workplace accident.
amharic: በሚዙሪ፣ ሀንትስቪል በተካሄደ የፍርድ ቤት ማዘዣ አፈጻጸም ወቅት፣ የፖሊስ ቡድን የቆመበት የእንጨት በረንዳ በመውደቁ በርካታ መኮንኖች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። የሰውነት ካሜራዎች ክስተቱ በተፈጠረበት ወቅት የ SWAT ቡድን አባላት እና የዩኤስ ማርሻል ሰራተኞች በስራ ላይ እንደነበሩ ያሳያሉ። ባለስልጣናት በአጋጣሚ ስለተከሰተው የዚህ የሥራ ቦታ አደጋ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Magaalaa Huntsville, Missouri keessatti poolisoonni ajaja seeraa raawwataa turan, dallaan isaan irra dhaabatanii turan diigamee kufnaan miidhaan irra ga'eera. Viidiyoon kaameraa qaamaa akka agarsiisutti, gareen SWAT fi poolisoonni federaalaa bakka sana osoo jiranu caasaan sun tasa kutee kuseera. Aangeyyoonni balaa tasaa hojii irratti isaan mudate kana hordofaa jiru.

title: Publisher of US military newspaper resigns over differences with government
english: Max D. Lederer Jr., the long-standing publisher of the U.S. military newspaper Stars and Stripes, has resigned due to fundamental disagreements with the Trump administration. He cited concerns regarding the government's attempt to exert more editorial influence over the publication's content. This move follows recent criticism from defense officials who accused the newspaper of focusing on inappropriate topics rather than government priorities.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ጋዜጣ የሆነው 'ስታርስ ኤንድ ስትራይፕስ' ዋና አሳታሚ ማክስ ዲ ሌደሬር ጁኒየር፣ ከመንግስት አካላት ጋር ባላቸው የመርህ ልዩነት ምክንያት ከስልጣናቸው ለቀዋል። አሳታሚው የመልቀቂያ ውሳኔያቸውን የወሰኑት የአሜሪካ መከላከያ ሚኒስቴር በጋዜጣው የአርትኦት ስራ ላይ ጣልቃ ለመግባት ጥረት በማድረጉ ነው። የትራምፕ አስተዳደር ጋዜጣው የመንግስትን አቅጣጫ እንዲከተል ቢፈልግም፣ አሳታሚው ይህ የጋዜጣውን ነጻነት የሚጋፋ መሆኑን በመግለጽ ስልጣናቸውን ለቀዋል።
oromo: Max D. Lederer Jr. maxxansaan gaazexaa waraana Ameerikaa 'Stars and Stripes' jedhamuu, mootummaa waliin walii galuu dhabuun isaatiin hojiisaa gadi lakkiseera. Hojiin gadi lakkisuun isaa kanneen mootummaan contenti gaazexichaa irratti dhiibbaa gochuuf yaaluu isaa mormuufi. Mootummaan Trump gaazexichi ajaja isaanii akka hordofu barbaadus, maxxansaan kun gaazexichi bilisummaa isaa eeggachuu qaba jechuun murteesseera.

title: ‘Tsunami’ of emigration reshapes Israel’s future, experts warn
english: In recent years, Israel has faced a significant rise in emigration, with nearly 270,000 citizens moving abroad since 2023. Many of those departing are wealthy and highly educated individuals who feel disillusioned by the government's right-wing policies, political instability, and ongoing regional conflicts. Experts warn that this shift threatens the nation's future as it struggles with a loss of skilled talent and growing internal societal divisions.
amharic: ባለፉት ሶስት አመታት ውስጥ ወደ 270,000 የሚጠጉ እስራኤላውያን ሀገራቸውን ለቀው በመውጣታቸው እስራኤል ከፍተኛ የስደተኞች ቁጥር መጨመር እያስተናገደች ነው። አብዛኛዎቹ ሀገር ጥለው የሚሄዱት የተማሩ እና ሀብታም ዜጎች ሲሆኑ፣ ለዚህም እንደ ዋና ምክንያቶች የሀገሪቱን መንግስት ፖሊሲ፣ የፖለቲካ አለመረጋጋት እና ቀጣይነት ያለው የጦርነት ሁኔታን ይጠቅሳሉ። ይህ ሁኔታ በሀገሪቱ የሰለጠነ የሰው ኃይል እጥረት እንዲፈጠር እና የወደፊት የሀገሪቱ ዕድገት ላይ ስጋት እንዲደቀን ባለሙያዎች ያስጠነቅቃሉ።
oromo: Ganna sadan darban keessatti namoonni Israa’el keessaa gara 270,000 ta’an biyyattii gadhiisanii ba’uun isaanii biyyattii keessatti yaaddoo guddaa uumeera. Namoonni ba’aa jiran kun baay’een isaanii namoota beekumsa qabanii fi qabeenya qaban yoo ta’an, sababii ijoo godhatanis siyaasa mootummaa gara mirgaatti maxxane, tasgabbii dhabuu fi waraana iddoo garagaraa keessatti itti fufeen kan mufatan dha. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, namoota beekumsa qaban kana dhabuun kun gara fuulduraatti dinagdee fi hawaasummaa Israa’el irratti dhiibbaa hamaa akka qabu akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: UK condemns Israel's E1 settlement expansion in occupied West Bank
english: The UK Foreign Secretary has strongly condemned Israel's decision to advance settlement construction in the E1 area of the West Bank, labeling it a destructive move that harms the possibility of a two-state solution. Britain has demanded an immediate halt to these plans and warned that it is preparing to impose sanctions on those facilitating illegal settlement expansion. Officials emphasized that such actions jeopardize regional peace and security while causing severe damage to Palestinian communities.
amharic: የብሪታንያ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር በእስራኤል የተያዘው ምዕራባዊ ባንክ በሚገኘው የኢ-1 ሰፈራ ግንባታ ላይ እስራኤል የወሰደችውን እርምጃ አጥብቀው አውግዘዋል። ብሪታንያ ይህ ድርጊት የሁለት ሀገር መፍትሄን አደጋ ላይ የሚጥል አጥፊ አካሄድ ነው ስትል፣ እቅዱን በአስቸኳይ እንዲያቆሙና ለሰፈራ መስፋፋት ተባባሪ የሆኑ አካላት ላይ ማዕቀብ ለመጣል ዝግጅት እያደረገች መሆኑን አስታውቃለች። የብሪታንያ መንግስት ይህ ውሳኔ በክልሉ ሰላም እና በፓለስቲናውያን ማህበረሰብ ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት የሚያደርስ መሆኑን ገልጿል።
oromo: Ministeerri Dhimma Alaa biyya Ingiliz, Israa'el naannoo E1 kan Qarqara Lixaa (West Bank) keessatti ijaarsa iddoo qubannaa babal'isuuf murteessiteetti mormii cimaa qaqqabsiiseera. Ingiliz murteen kun furmaata biyyoota lamaa (two-state solution) kan diiguu fi nageenya naannichaa kan jeequ ta'uu ibsuun, Israa'el ijaarsa kana hatattamaan akka dhaabdu gaafatteetti. Kana malees, babal'ina iddoo qubannaa seeraan alaa kana irratti hirmaatan irratti tarkaanfiin adabbii (sanctions) akka fudhatamuuf qophaa'aa akka jirtu beeksisteetti.

title: Israel's Bennett calls for Qatar, Turkey's exclusion from future role in Gaza
english: Former Israeli Prime Minister Naftali Bennett has publicly argued against involving Qatar and Turkey in the post-war administration of Gaza. He claimed that these two nations would only serve to bolster Hamas. Instead, he suggested that a collaborative effort between Israel and Egypt would be the most effective way to neutralize the group.
amharic: የእስራኤል የቀድሞ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ናፍታሊ ቤኔት፣ ኳታር እና ቱርክ ከጦርነት በኋላ በጋዛ አስተዳደር ውስጥ ሚና እንዳይኖራቸው ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። እነዚህ አገራት በጋዛ ውስጥ መሳተፋቸው የሀማስን አቅም እንደሚያጠናክር ገልጸዋል። በምትኩ፣ እስራኤል እና ግብፅ በመተባበር የጋዛን ጉዳይ ቢመሩ ሀማስን ለማስወገድ ይረዳል ሲሉ ተከራክረዋል።
oromo: Muummee ministiraa duraanii kan Israa'el Naftaalii Benet, biyyoonni Kaataar fi Tarkii fuulduratti bulchiinsa Gaazaa keessatti hirmaachuu akka hin qabne dubbataniiru. Biyyoonni kun Gaazaa keessatti hirmaachuun isaanii garee Haamaas akka cimsu ibsaniiru. Kanaa mannaa, Israa'el fi Gibxi waliigaltee uumuun Gaazaa hogganuun Haamaas balleessuuf filannoo gaarii ta'uu isaa dubbataniiru.

title: Trump says US launching 'economic warfare' against Iran, warns countries not to back Tehran
english: President Trump has announced an aggressive campaign of economic warfare intended to isolate Iran and dismantle its military and financial capabilities. He warned that any nations providing support to Tehran will face severe consequences from the United States. The administration aims to neutralize Iran's influence and ensure the country is unable to develop nuclear weapons.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ኢራንን ለመነጠል እና የሀገሪቱን ወታደራዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ አቅም ለማዳከም ያለመ ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ ጦርነት ማወጃቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ለቴህራን ድጋፍ የሚሰጡ ማናቸውም ሀገራት ከአሜሪካ ጠንካራ እርምጃ እንደሚወሰድባቸው አስጠንቅቀዋል። የአሜሪካ አስተዳደር የኢራንን ተጽዕኖ ለመግታት እና ሀገሪቱ የኒውክሌር ጦር መሳሪያ እንዳትይዝ ለመከላከል ይህንን እርምጃ እንደወሰደ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Traamp Iraan addunyaa irraa addaan baasuuf akkasumas humna waraanaa fi diinagdee ishee laaffisuuf xiyyeeffannoon kan gaggeeffamu 'waraana diinagdee' akka labsan beeksisaniiru. Biyyoonni kamiyyuu Teheran deeggaru irratti tarkaanfiin cimaan akka fudhatamu akeekkachiisaniiru. Bulchiinsi Ameerikaa dhiibbaa Iraan laaffisuuf fi biyyattiin meeshaa niwukilaaraa akka hin arganne ittisuuf tarkaanfii kana fudhatuu ibsameera.

title: Harry Kane scores goal by winning Golden Shoe for the second time
english: Harry Kane has earned the prestigious European Golden Shoe award for the second time in his professional career. The Bayern Munich forward secured the title by outperforming other elite strikers, including Erling Haaland and Kylian Mbappé. This recognition highlights his exceptional scoring performance during the season.
amharic: የባየር ሙኒክ አጥቂ ሃሪ ኬን በሙያዊ ህይወቱ ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ የአውሮፓ ምርጥ ግብ አስቆጣሪ በመባል የጎልደን ሹ ሽልማትን አሸንፏል። የእንግሊዝ ብሔራዊ ቡድን አጥቂው እንደ ኤርሊንግ ሃላንድ እና ኪሊያን ምባፔ ካሉ ታላላቅ ተጫዋቾች በልጦ በመገኘት ይህንን ክብር ተጎናጽፏል። ይህም የውድድር ዘመኑን አስደናቂ የግል ብቃቱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Hiri Keeniin miila isaanii kan Baayer Muuniik taphatu, badhaasa 'Goliden Shuu' kan warra Awurooppaa keessatti goliin hedduu galcheef kennamu yeroo lammaffaaf injifateera. Keeniin taphattoota beekamoo akka Erling Haalaandiifi Kiliyaan Embaappee caaluun badhaasa kana fudhateera. Injifannoon kun raawwii isaanii kan yeroo darbe keessatti dandeettii goliin galchuun qaban kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Nigeria’s election campaign begins with Tinubu facing a reform test
english: As Nigeria enters its 2027 election campaign cycle, President Bola Tinubu faces significant pressure due to a difficult economic climate characterized by rising costs of living. While his administration claims that unpopular reforms like ending fuel subsidies are essential for long-term stability, many citizens are struggling with decreased purchasing power. The upcoming race will likely be influenced by these economic hardships alongside political fragmentation among the opposition.
amharic: ናይጄሪያ የ2027 ምርጫ ቅስቀሳ ስትጀምር፣ ፕሬዝዳንት ቦላ ቲኑቡ በኑሮ ውድነት ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ ገጥሟቸዋል። መንግስት የነዳጅ ድጎማን ጨምሮ ያደረጋቸው የኢኮኖሚ ማሻሻያዎች ለረጅም ጊዜ ዘላቂ ጥቅም እንዳላቸው ቢገልጹም፣ አብዛኞቹ ዜጎች በአሁኑ ወቅት የገንዘብ አቅም ችግር ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። የመጪው ምርጫ ውጤትም በነዚህ የኢኮኖሚ ጫናዎች እና በተቃዋሚዎች መካከል ባለው መከፋፈል የሚወሰን ይሆናል።
oromo: Naayijeeriyaan gara sagantaa filannoo bara 2027 yommuu seentutti, pirezidaant Bola Tiinuubun baasii jireenyaa olka’eefii rakkoo dinagdee mudateen walqabatee mormii cimaan isaan mudateera. Mootummaan jijjiirama dinagdee garagaraa, kanneen akka gargaarsa boba’aa dhaabuu, bu’aa yeroo dheeraa qabu jedhee kan amanu ta’us, lammiileen hedduun jireenya guyyuu keessatti rakkoo dinagdee cimaa keessa jiru. Filannoon dhufu kunis dhiibbaa dinagdee kanaafi garee mormituu gidduutti walitti bu’iinsa jiruun kan murtaa’u ta’a.

title: Iran war live: Trump announces ‘most crushing’ Iran sanctions
english: President Donald Trump has declared the implementation of severe new economic sanctions against Iran following the collapse of negotiations between the two nations. The United States has warned that any country that assists Iran financially will face harsh penalties. Despite this escalation, Trump indicated that future talks remain a possibility, provided that Iran commits to stopping its nuclear weapons program.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል የተደረገው ድርድር ባለመሳካቱ በኢራን ላይ ከፍተኛ የሆነ አዲስ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ መጣላቸውን አስታውቀዋል። አሜሪካ ለኢራን የገንዘብ ድጋፍ የሚያደርግ ማንኛውም አካል ጠንካራ እርምጃ እንደሚወሰድበት አስጠንቅቃለች። ይሁን እንጂ ትራምፕ ኢራን የኒውክሌር ፕሮግራሟን እስካቆመች ድረስ ለወደፊቱ ድርድር የመቀጠል እድል እንዳለ ጠቁመዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Doolaard Tiraamp mariin biyyoota lamaan gidduutti godhamaa ture fashalaachuu hordofee, Iran irratti tarkaanfiin diinagdee cimaan fudhatamuu beeksisaniiru. Ameerikaan biyyi kamiyyuu Iran gargaarsa maallaqaa yoo goote, adabbii cimaan akka irratti fudhatamu akeekkachiisteetti. Ta'us, Tiraamp Iran sagantaa meeshaa niwukilaraa ishee yoo dhaabde, gara fuulduraatti mariin itti fufuu akka danda'u ibsaniiru.

title: US national debt passes record $40 trillion
english: The United States national debt has officially exceeded $40 trillion, effectively doubling over the past decade. This significant rise is attributed to heavy government borrowing during the COVID-19 pandemic and extensive spending on infrastructure and social programs under both the Trump and Biden administrations. Experts warn that this growing debt burden threatens long-term economic stability and increases the cost of living for American citizens.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ብሔራዊ ዕዳ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ 40 ትሪሊዮን ዶላር በማለፍ ባለፉት አስር ዓመታት ውስጥ በእጥፍ አድጓል። ይህ ከፍተኛ ዕድገት የተከሰተው በኮቪድ-19 ወረርሽኝ ወቅት በተደረገው ከፍተኛ የወጪ መተግበር እና በፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ እና ባይደን አስተዳደሮች በተከናወኑ የመሠረተ ልማት እና ሌሎች ፕሮጀክቶች ምክንያት ነው። የኢኮኖሚ ባለሙያዎች ይህ እያደገ የመጣ የዕዳ መጠን ለሀገሪቱ የረዥም ጊዜ ኢኮኖሚያዊ መረጋጋት ስጋት እንደሚፈጥር እና የኑሮ ውድነትን እንደሚጨምር አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Hiriin biyyaalessaa kan Ameerikaa yeroo jalqabaaf dolaara tiriliyoona 40 kan darbe yoo ta'u, kurnan waggoota darban keessatti dachaan dabaleera. Daballiin guddaan kun dhukkuba kovid-19 yeroo turetti baasii mootummaan godhe, akkasumas sirna Trump fi Biden jalatti piroojektiiwwan misoomaa fi kanneen biroo irratti baasii guddaa baasuun kan dhufe dha. Hayyoonni dinagdee akka jedhanitti, hiriin kun guddachaa deemun isaa nageenya dinagdee biyyattii irratti balaa kan qabuufi gatiin jireenyaa akka dabalu gochuu isaa akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: ‘We do not trust Israeli judiciary’ says Hind Rajab’s grandmother
english: The grandmother of five-year-old Hind Rajab, who was killed alongside six relatives by Israeli forces in Gaza earlier this year, has rejected the credibility of an Israeli criminal investigation into the incident. She stated that she has no faith in the Israeli judicial system to provide justice for her granddaughter’s death. The family remains deeply skeptical of any official inquiry conducted by the same forces responsible for the tragedy.
amharic: በጋዛ በእስራኤል ኃይሎች ከተገደለችው የአምስት ዓመቷ ሂንድ ራጃብ አያት፣ የእስራኤል መንግሥት በልጅ ልጇ ሞት ላይ የጀመረውን የወንጀል ምርመራ እንደማትቀበለው ገለጹ። አያቷ የእስራኤል የፍትህ ስርዓት ፍትህን ይሰጣል ብለው እንደማያምኑ ተናግረዋል። ቤተሰቡ በግድያው ተጠያቂ ናቸው ብለው በሚያምኑት ወገን የሚካሄድ ማናቸውንም ምርመራ በጥርጣሬ ይመለከቱታል።
oromo: Gaza keessatti humnoota Israa’eliin kan ajjeefamte mucayyoo waggaa shan Hind Rajab, akaakayyoonshee qorannoo Israa’el du’ashee irratti jalqabe hin amannu jedhan. Akaakayyoonshee sirni seeraa Israa’el haqa ni argamsiisa jedhanii akka hin amanne ibsaniiru. Maatiin sun du’a mucayyoo isaanii kanaaf kan itti gaafatamu mootummaa Israa’el waan ta’eef, qorannoo isaan gaggeessan kamiyyuu akka hin amanne beeksisaniiru.

title: Pentagon quizzes NATO allies on political loyalty, documents reveal
english: The Pentagon has issued a questionnaire to NATO allies to evaluate their support for President Trump’s foreign policy and military objectives. The document specifically asks whether member nations are aligning with US positions regarding the Middle East and if they are willing to lift restrictions on American military access to their bases. Critics and foreign officials worry that this move unfairly pressures NATO members to participate in unilateral US operations outside the alliance's traditional scope.
amharic: የፔንታጎን አስተዳደር የኔቶ አባል ሀገራት ለፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕ የውጭ ጉዳይ ፖሊሲ ያላቸውን ድጋፍ ለመገምገም መጠይቅ ልኳል። ይህ ሰነድ አባል ሀገራት በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ጉዳዮች ላይ ከአሜሪካ ጋር ያላቸውን አቋም እና ለጦር ሰፈሮቿ የሚሰጡትን ፈቃድ በተመለከተ ጥያቄዎችን ያነሳል። የኔቶ አባል ሀገራት በህብረቱ ስምምነት ውጪ በሆኑ የአሜሪካ የጦር እንቅስቃሴዎች ውስጥ እንዲሳተፉ መገደዳቸው አሳሳቢ መሆኑን ባለሙያዎች ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Pentagoniin biyyoota miseensa NATO ta'aniif, imaammata alaa kan Prezidaant Traamp deggeruu isaanii fi dhiisuu isaanii qorachuuf gaaffilee qopheesseera. Sanadichi biyyoonni kunneen dhimma Baha Giddu-galeessaa irratti sadarkaa fedhii Ameerikaa waliin akka hiriiran fi buufataalee waraanaa isaanii irratti ittisa jiru akka kaasan gaafata. Akkaataa kanaan, Ameerikaan biyyoota NATO walitti bu'iinsa waraanaa kanneen maqaa NATOtiin ala ta'an keessatti akka hirmaatan dhiibbaa gochaa jirti jechuun namoonni dhimmi kun isaan yaaddesse komataniiru.

title: Lebanon hands former Syrian army general to Damascus after arrest warrant
english: Lebanon has extradited former Syrian Major-General Adel Issa to Damascus to face serious criminal charges, including torture and murder. This marks the first time Lebanon has transferred a former Syrian military official to the new government since the collapse of the Assad regime in 2024. Issa was arrested in Lebanon after visiting the Syrian embassy, following a widespread effort by Syrian authorities to hold former regime members accountable.
amharic: ሊባኖስ የቀድሞውን የሶሪያ ጦር ጄኔራል አዴል ኢሳን በሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰት እና በግድያ ወንጀል እንዲጠየቁ ለደማስቆ አስረክባለች። ይህ እርምጃ የባሻር አል-አሳድ አስተዳደር በ2024 ከወደቀ በኋላ ሊባኖስ በቀድሞ የሶሪያ ባለስልጣን ላይ የወሰደችው የመጀመሪያው የውክልና እርምጃ ነው። ጄኔራሉ በሊባኖስ በሚገኘው የሶሪያ ኤምባሲ በነበሩበት ወቅት በቁጥጥር ስር ውለው ነበር፣ ይህም በሶሪያ አዲስ መንግስት እየተካሄደ ካለው የቀድሞ ባለስልጣናትን የማደን ዘመቻ አንዱ ነው።
oromo: Libanoon ajaja waraanaa Siiriyaa duraanii jeneraal Adel Issaa, himata ajjeechaa fi dararamaa dabalatee yakka cimaan himatamuuf gara Daamaasqootti dabarsitee kenniteetti. Tarkaanfiin kun mootummaan Bashar al-Assad bara 2024 erga kufee booda, Libanoon qondaala waraana Siiriyaa duraanii gara biyyaatti erguun ishee yeroo jalqabaati. Jeneraalichi kan qabaman embasii Siiriyaa kan Libanoo keessa jiru yeroo daawwatan ta'ee, kunis mootummaan Siiriyaa haaraan qondaaltota mootummaa duraanii irratti tarkaanfii fudhachuu jalqabuu isaa kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Trump announces ‘most crushing economic operation ever’ against Iran
english: US President Donald Trump has declared a massive new economic offensive against Iran, citing the failure of recent negotiations to end their ongoing conflict. He warned that any nation continuing to trade with Iran will face severe financial repercussions from the United States. Through these unprecedented sanctions, Trump aims to isolate the Iranian government and severely damage its economy.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በኢራን ላይ ታይቶ የማይታወቅ ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ መጣላቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የመጣው በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለው ግጭት መፍትሄ ሳያገኝ በመቆየቱ ነው። ከኢራን ጋር የንግድ ግንኙነት የሚያደርጉ ሀገራትም ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ ቅጣት እንደሚጠብቃቸው ፕሬዚዳንቱ አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp, mariin nageenyaa kan biyyoota lamaanii milkaa'uu dhabuu hordofee, Itoophiyaa irratti tarkaanfiin diinagdee cimaan fudhatamuu isaa beeksisaniiru. Biyyootni Itoophiyaa waliin daldala itti fufan hundi adabbii diinagdee cimaan akka irra ga'u akeekkachiisaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun Itoophiyaa addunyaa irraa fageessuufi diinagdee ishee miidhuuf kan karoorfameedha.

title: Blast heard in Syria's Daraa
english: Syrian state media reported that a loud explosion occurred in the countryside of Daraa, a region in the southwestern part of the country. Details regarding the cause of the blast or any resulting casualties remain unknown. Authorities have not yet provided further information about the incident.
amharic: የሶሪያ የመንግስት ሚዲያዎች በደቡብ ምዕራብ ሶሪያ በምትገኘው የዳራ ግዛት ገጠር አካባቢ ከፍተኛ ፍንዳታ እንደተሰማ ዘግበዋል። የፍንዳታው መንስኤ ምን እንደሆነ ወይም ስለደረሰው ጉዳት እስካሁን የታወቀ ነገር የለም። ባለስልጣናት ስለሁኔታው ተጨማሪ መግለጫ አልሰጡም።
oromo: Miidiyaaleen mootummaa Suuriyaa akka gabaasanitti, naannoo magaalaa Daaraa kan kibba-lixaa biyyattitti argamutti dhoohaan guddaan tokko dhaga'ameera. Sababa dhoohichaa fi miidhaa ga'e ilaalchisee odeeffannoon beekame hin jiru. Aangeyyoonni mootummaa haalicha irratti ibsa dabalataa hin kennine.

title: Jury refuses to convict seven Palestine Action defendants over Elbit raid
english: A London jury was unable to reach a verdict for seven Palestine Action activists accused of breaking into an Israeli-owned arms factory near Bristol. While one individual was found guilty of criminal damage, the court could not decide on the charges of violent disorder and property damage for the others. Consequently, prosecutors may now seek a retrial for the seven defendants involved in the 2024 protest incident.
amharic: የለንደን ፍርድ ቤት ዳኞች በብሪስቶል አቅራቢያ በሚገኝ የእስራኤል የጦር መሳሪያ ፋብሪካ ላይ ወረራ ፈጽመዋል በተባሉ ሰባት የፍልስጤም አክቲቪስቶች ላይ ውሳኔ መስጠት አልቻሉም። ከአንደኛው ተከሳሽ በስተቀር የቀሩት ተከሳሾች በንብረት ውድመት እና በሁከት ወንጀል የቀረበባቸው ክስ በአንድነት ሊረጋገጥ አልቻለም። በዚህም ምክንያት ለሰባቱ ተከሳሾች ዳግም ሙከራ ሊደረግላቸው እንደሚችል ተገልጿል።
oromo: Abbootiin seeraa London, warshaa meeshaa waraanaa kan Israa'el ta'e kan Bristolitti argamu cabsee seene jedhamanii kan himataman qabsaa'ota 'Palestine Action' torba irratti murtoo irra gahuu hin dandeenye. Namni tokko yakka qabeenya mancaasuu irratti yakkamus, himannaan warra kaanii garuu hin mirkanaa'in hafeera. Kanaafuu, himatamtoonni torba kun qabxiiwwan himannaa isaanirratti dhihaateen deebii irratti murtoo kennuuf qormaanni biraa akka isaan mudatuuf jira.

title: Australia summons Israeli ambassador over Gaza aid worker killing
english: The Australian government has summoned the Israeli ambassador to express strong dissatisfaction after Israel decided not to launch criminal investigations into the deaths of seven World Central Kitchen aid workers. Among the victims was Australian citizen Zomi Frankcom, who was killed in a 2024 airstrike in Gaza. Foreign Minister Penny Wong stated that the lack of accountability is unacceptable and expressed deep outrage at Israel's stance.
amharic: አውስትራሊያ ሰባት የዓለም ማዕከላዊ ኩሽና የረድኤት ሠራተኞችን በአየር ድብደባ ለገደለው እስራኤል ላይ የወንጀል ምርመራ እንደማይደረግ መወሰኗን ተከትሎ የእስራኤልን አምባሳደር ጠርታለች። በዚህ ጥቃት ከተገደሉት መካከል አውስትራሊያዊቷ ዞሚ ፍራንኮም ትገኝበታለች። የአውስትራሊያ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ፔኒ ዎንግ ውሳኔው ተጠያቂነትን የማያረጋግጥ በመሆኑ ከፍተኛ ቅሬታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Awustiraaliyaa Israa'el hojjattoota gargaarsa torba ajjeesuu ishee ilaalchisee qorannoo yakkaa banuu dhiisuu isheetiin wal qabatee, ambaasaaddara Israa'el waamsiseera. Ajjeechaa bara 2024 Gaazaatti raawwatame kanaan namoota ajjeefaman keessaa lammiin Awustiraaliyaa Zomi Frankcom tokko turte. Ministirri Dhimmi Alaa Awustiraaliyaa Peni Wong, tarkiinichi itti gaafatamummaa kan hin mirkaneessine ta'uu ibsuun mufii guddaa qaban ibsaniiru.

title: Bahrain says Israeli attack on Syrian air base violates international law
english: Bahrain has officially denounced the recent Israeli airstrikes on a Syrian air base, labeling the action a breach of Syria's sovereignty. The Bahraini government argued that this military move violates international laws and the UN Charter while endangering regional stability. Through this statement, Bahrain reaffirmed its commitment to upholding the independence and territorial integrity of Syria.
amharic: ባህሬን በቅርቡ እስራኤል በሶሪያ የአየር ማረፊያ ላይ የፈጸመችውን ጥቃት የሶሪያን ሉዓላዊነት የጣሰ ተግባር ነው በማለት በይፋ አውግዛለች። የባህሬን መንግስት ይህ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ ዓለም አቀፍ ህጎችን እና የተባበሩት መንግስታት ቻርተርን እንደሚጥስ እና የክልሉን ሰላም አደጋ ላይ እንደሚጥል ገልጿል። በዚህ መግለጫ አማካኝነት ባህሬን የሶሪያን ነጻነት እና የግዛት አንድነት ለመጠበቅ ያላትን ቁርጠኝነት አረጋግጣለች።
oromo: Bahrain miidhaa waraana Israa'el buufata xiyyaaraa Suuriyaatti raawwate kana seeraan ala fi kabaja biyyaalessaa Suuriyaatti cabsuu dha jechuun balaaleffatteetti. Mootummaan Bahrain tarkaanfiin kun seera idil-addunyaa fi seera Tokkummaa Mootummootaa kan cabsu fi tasgabbii naannichaa kan booressu ta'uu ibseera. Ibsa kanaan, Bahrain kabaja biyyaalessaa fi walitti qalamuu daangaa Suuriyaaf gumaacha gochuuf qabdu mirkaneessiteetti.

title: US elections: Progressive Democrat scores shock win in Florida
english: In recent US primary elections, Florida state Representative Angie Nixon achieved a surprise victory over a well-funded opponent despite significantly lower campaign spending. Her platform focused on anti-war policies, healthcare access, and affordable housing. Meanwhile, other races in Alaska and Florida highlighted the continued influence of establishment politicians and groups like Aipac, despite challenges from candidates critical of US foreign policy in the Middle East.
amharic: በቅርቡ በተደረጉት የአሜሪካ የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ምርጫዎች፣ የፍሎሪዳ ተወካይ አንጂ ኒክሰን ብዙ በጀት ካለው ተፎካካሪያቸው በተሻለ ሁኔታ ባልተጠበቀ ሁኔታ አሸንፈዋል። የኒክሰን ዘመቻ በጦርነት ተቃውሞ፣ በጤና አገልግሎት እና በተመጣጣኝ የቤት ዋጋ ላይ ያተኮረ ነበር። በሌላ በኩል በአላስካ እና ፍሎሪዳ የተካሄዱት ምርጫዎች፣ በአሜሪካ የውጭ ጉዳይ ፖሊሲ ላይ ትችት በሚሰነዝሩ እጩዎች ቢፈታተኑም፣ ዋና ዋና የፖለቲካ ተቋማት እና የኤይፓክ (Aipac) ተፅዕኖ አሁንም ጠንካራ መሆኑን አሳይተዋል።
oromo: Filannoo duraa kan Yunaayitid Isteetis dhiheenya adeemsifameen, bakka buutuun mootummaa Florida Angie Nixon morkataa baajata guddaa qabu injifachuun nama dinqisiise. Duulli isheen geggeessites mormii waraanaa, tajaajila fayyaa fi gabaa mana jireenyaa irratti xiyyeeffate. Gama biraatiin, filannoon Alaska fi Florida adeemsifame, namoonni siyaasa ala Yunaayitid Isteetis irratti komii qaban jiraatanis, dhaabbilee siyaasaa bebbeekamoo fi gareen Aipac jedhamu dhiibbaa guddaa qabaachuu isaanii mirkaneesseera.

title: Australia 'outraged' after Israeli decision not to prosecute over killing of aid worker in Gaza
english: The Australian government has expressed deep frustration following Israel's decision not to file criminal charges against those involved in the 2024 killing of aid worker Zomi Frankcom and her colleagues in Gaza. Foreign Minister Penny Wong described the lack of accountability as insulting, noting that the strikes were already admitted to be the result of procedural failures and errors. Australia intends to summon the Israeli ambassador to formally demand justice for the victims.
amharic: የአውስትራሊያ መንግስት በጋዛ የሰብአዊ እርዳታ ሰራተኛዋን ዞሚ ፍራንኮምን እና የስራ ባልደረቦቿን በገደሉት ላይ እስራኤል ክስ ላለመመስረት የወሰደችውን ውሳኔ ተከትሎ ከፍተኛ ቁጣውን ገልጿል። የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሯ ፔኒ ዎንግ ውሳኔው ተጠያቂነትን የሚያረጋግጥ ባለመሆኑ አሳፋሪ ነው ብለዋል። አውስትራሊያ ለሟቾች ፍትህ እንዲሰፍን የዲፕሎማሲ ጥረቷን እንደምትቀጥል እና የእስራኤልን አምባሳደር ጠርታ ማብራሪያ እንደምትጠይቅ አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Mootummaan Awustiraaliyaa akkaataa ajjeechaa hojjetaa gargaarsa namoomaa Zoomii Firaankoom fi hiriyoota ishee Gaazaatti raawwatame ilaalchisee Israa'el namoota himataman irratti himata banuu dhiisuu ishee mormiteetti. Ministirri Dhimmi Alaa Peni Wong akka ibsetti, tarkiinni Israa'el kun itti gaafatamummaa kan hin mirkaneessine fi kan nama gaddisiisu dha. Awustiraaliyaan miidhamtootaaf haqni akka argamuuf ejjennoo ishee cimsitee itti fufuun, ambaasaaddara Israa'el waamtee mari'achuuf karoorfattetti.

title: What the social media addiction lawsuit could cost Meta
english: Meta is currently facing a major federal trial involving 29 states that accuse the company of designing Facebook and Instagram to be addictive for young users. If the court rules against the tech giant, the company could be forced to restructure its platforms and pay massive fines reaching up to $200 billion. This case poses a significant financial threat to Meta as it already struggles with declining internal morale and previous legal penalties.
amharic: ሜታ ፌስቡክ እና ኢንስታግራም ለወጣት ተጠቃሚዎች ሱስ የሚያስይዙ እንዲሆኑ ተደርገው የተሰሩ ናቸው በሚል በ29 ግዛቶች የተመሰረተበትን ትልቅ የፍርድ ቤት ክስ እየገጠመው ነው። ፍርድ ቤቱ በኩባንያው ላይ ውሳኔ ካሳለፈ፣ ሜታ የመድረኮቹን አወቃቀር እንዲቀይር እና እስከ 200 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የሚደርስ ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ቅጣት እንዲከፍል ሊገደድ ይችላል። ይህ ክስ ቀደም ሲል በኩባንያው ላይ የደረሱ የህግ ቅጣቶች እና የውስጥ ችግሮች እንዳሉበት ሁኔታ፣ ሜታ ላይ ትልቅ የገንዘብ ጫና ይፈጥራል።
oromo: Meta dhaabbilee mootummaa 29 ta'aniin Facebook fi Instagram ijoollee fi dargaggoota qabachuuf jedhanii akka fedhii isaanitti akka qophaa'an himatamee mana murtiitti dhiyaateera. Himata kana kan mo'atame yoo ta'e, Meta sirna platformii isaa jijjiiruu fi hanga biliyoona 200 doolaaraa kaffaluuf dirqamuu danda'a. Himanni kun Meta irratti dhiibbaa dinagdee cimaa uumuu kan danda'u yoo ta'u, kunis rakkoolee keessoo fi himata kanaan dura irratti dhiyaatan irratti kan dabalatuudha.

title: “I get along with him very well.”
english: US President Donald Trump has expressed positive sentiments regarding his relationship with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un. The two leaders are expected to hold a meeting later this year to discuss ongoing matters. This development follows President Trump's decision to reduce the scope of joint military exercises involving US and South Korean forces.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከሰሜን ኮሪያው መሪ ኪም ጆንግ ኡን ጋር ያላቸው ግንኙነት መልካም መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ሁለቱ መሪዎች በዓመቱ መጨረሻ ላይ ለመገናኘት እቅድ እንዳላቸው ተነግሯል። ይህ መግለጫ የተሰጠው ፕሬዚዳንቱ ከአሜሪካ እና ከደቡብ ኮሪያ ወታደሮች ጋር ሲካሄድ የነበረውን የጋራ ወታደራዊ ልምምድ እንዲቀንስ ትዕዛዝ ከሰጡ በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Prezidaantichi Amerikaa Donald Traamp hariiroo isaan hoogganaa Kooriyaa Kaabaa Kiim Joong Un waliin qaban gaarii akka ta'e ibsaniiru. Hoogganoonni kunneen dhimmoota garaagaraa mari'achuuf waggaa kana keessa wal arguuf karoorfataniiru. Taateen kun kan dhufe erga prezidaant Traamp humni waraanaa Ameerikaa fi Kooriyaa Kibbaa leenjii waraanaa waliinii irratti godhaa turan akka hir'atu ajajanii booda dha.

title: Israeli strike on Gaza City police headquarters kills women’s police chief
english: An Israeli airstrike targeting a police headquarters in Gaza City resulted in the deaths of the head of the women’s police force, multiple officers, and a teenager. This lethal operation occurred shortly after a diplomatic visit by a US envoy concluded without achieving a ceasefire agreement. The incident highlights the ongoing violence in the region despite recent international efforts to de-escalate the conflict.
amharic: በጋዛ ከተማ በሚገኝ የፖሊስ ዋና መሥሪያ ቤት ላይ እስራኤል ባደረሰችው የአየር ጥቃት የሴቶች ፖሊስ አዛዥ፣ በርካታ መኮንኖች እና አንድ የ13 ዓመት ታዳጊ ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ይህ ጥቃት የተፈጸመው የአሜሪካው ልዑክ ጃሬድ ኩሽነር የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ላይ ሳይደርሱ ጉብኝታቸውን ካጠናቀቁ ከሁለት ቀናት በኋላ ነው። ይህ ክስተት በክልሉ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን ግጭት እና የሰላም ጥረቶች እየተገዳደሩ መሆኑን የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el waajjira poolisii magaala Gaza irratti haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwateen ajajaan poolisii dubartootaa, poolisoonni biroo fi ijoolleen umriin isaanii waggaa 13 tokko du'aniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame ergamtootni Ameerikaa walii galtee dhaabbii waraanaa irratti osoo hin marihatin daawwannaa isaanii erga xumuranii guyyaa lama booda. Gochi kun haala waraanaa naannichatti jiru kan agarsiisu yoo ta'u, carraaqqiin nagaa buusuuf godhamaa jiru milkaa'ina dhabuu isaa kan mul'isuudha.

title: Displaced Lebanese watch southern Lebanon’s ‘pilot zones’ from afar
english: Many Lebanese citizens who fled their homes in the southern part of the country are now forced to watch from a distance as Israeli forces conduct military operations in the region. These displaced families are witnessing the destruction of their towns and villages, which are being identified as 'pilot zones.' Residents report feeling helpless as they observe the ongoing devastation of their communities from afar.
